In the most powerful episode ever, two people from the same family drown. The remaining family members watch as lifeguards attempt to resuscitate them, marking a crisis not faced by lifeguards since 1939.

At the south end a man screams in pain from a dislocated hip, but lifeguards Beardy and Harrison are taken by surprise when the man's friend has a seizure just metres away.

Snoop Dogg visits Bondi on New Years. Lifeguards arrive at 5am, rescuing partygoers from rips. One girl loses consciousness, but lifeguard suspect she is a serial offender intentionally endangering herself. The emergency chopper is called for a missing swimmer last seen in the water two hours ago.

A woman walks naked on the beach, discarding towels offered by Harries before strolling onto the Bondi streets. Another woman is removed by police for drunkenly harassing beachgoers. And lifeguards build the wildest boats imaginable for the end of season 'Surf-en-tag' wave riding competition."

Despite being an overweight kid without a surfing background, Reidy has overcome harsh criticism to become a lifeguard, setting his sights on a world record. Lifeguards must rescue a girl blown kilometres out to sea on a paddle board. A BMX rider has a fractured cheek and broken nose.

Shark season hits Australia's East Coast as a large bull shark prompts lifeguards to sound the alarm, clearing thousands of swimmers from the water. Bondi's first Italian lifeguard Mario faces a major test, and a miscommunication raises concerns about a potentially lost swimmer in the surf.

On the day of the lifeguard challenge, Max and Jesse chase an inflatable boat ride, leading to further trouble when Jesse gets a buoy rope stuck in the jetski intake. The lifeguards deal with tourists using cheap boogie boards whose arm leashes break, causing them to quickly sink in deep water.

Mouse accidentally turns off his radio, putting lives at risk. A giant bait ball is spotted off Bondi Beach. The public reports a shark sighting, leading to the shark alarm being set off. Lifeguards engage in a mass rescue.

The mission will not be easy, for Danny and his team must cut their way through Spike (Clive Owen) and a team of assassins known as the Feather Men.

Follows Captain Alexei Vostrikov who, at the height of the Cold War, is ordered to take over command of the nuclear missile submarine K-19, pride of the Soviet Navy. His assignment: Prepare the K-19 for sea and take her out on patrol -- no matter what the cost. But problems with the K-19 arise that may lead to a core meltdown and explosion that will certainly kill all aboard, and possibly trigger a nuclear war. Vostrikov must choose between his orders and the lives of his men.

After a string of bizarre bank robberies in Southern California, with the crooks donning masks of various former presidents, a federal agent, Johnny Utah (Keanu Reeves), infiltrates the suspected gang. But when Utah falls in love with a female surfer, Tyler (Lori Petty), who is close to the gang, it complicates his sense of duty.

In 1986, federal agent Robert Mazur (Bryan Cranston) goes undercover to infiltrate the trafficking network of Colombian drug kingpin Pablo Escobar. Working with fellow agents Kathy Ertz (Diane Kruger) and Emir Abreu (John Leguizamo), Mazur poses as a slick, money-laundering businessman named Bob Musella. Gaining the confidence of Roberto Alcaino (Benjamin Bratt), Escobar's top lieutenant, Mazur must navigate a vicious criminal underworld where one wrong move could cost him everything.

Unfortunately, Aladeen has a less-than-friendly reception from exiled Wadiyans, who want their country freed from his despotic rule.

Strawberry opens her front door to a throng of Berrykins all cheering for the new BerryFest Princess. She is appreciative of their admiration but unsure of exactly what her duties entail. In response the Berrykins bombard her with her duties - major to miniscule. One Berrykin sums it up by telling her she's responsible for presiding over all the activities of the BerryFest to make it the best.

All of Berry Bitty City is excitedly making their way through the berry batch in search of the elusive Wanderberry. It is to be the dessert at the BerryFest Feast. Everyone is milling about searching for it on their own when Blueberry points out that the rules say the BerryFest Princess is in charge of the search. The girls turn to her for direction and she points them where she thinks the berry might be.

programmes.st: Nothing To Fear But Berries Themselves
programmes.d: Overhearing Blueberry reading a story to the baby Berrykins about the scary Galumphalot, Orange is uncharacteristically shaken. She determines she doesn't want anything scary around her, just relaxation. But while the girls are having a hair-styling party at Lemon's salon, a malfunction at the BerryWorks causes the whole town to go dark. And Orange begins to get really anxious.

programmes.st: Where, Oh, Where Has Our Blueberry Gone?
programmes.d: Blueberry has become obsessed with the mystery book detective heroine, Patti Persimmon. She decorates her store with Patti posters and rearranges her shelves to make room for all the Patti books she's ordered. Blueberry begins to neglect outings with her friends and even goes so far as to dress like her idol just to emulate her. She then starts looking for cases to solve around town.

While in the midst of a cake decorating demonstration at the café, the girls are uncharacteristically interrupted by an excited Princess Berrykin. She announces the Berrykins have decided to revive the old tradition of the Berry Bitty Buggy Derby. While the girls enthusiastically recount the stories they've heard about it and ask the Princess questions, Blueberry, carrying enough books to block her view, comes through the door and unknowingly interrupts the Princess.

The grove around Berry Bitty City is abuzz with activity. The Berrykins are using their sparkles to harvest berries, Berrykin Bloom is in his garden spraying flowers with a special solution to make them larger, and Raspberry is nearby gathering flower petals to make perfume. The wind starts to blow and picks up some of the sparkles. The sparkles float along the wind and get combined with some of Berrykin Bloom's solution.

It's time again for the Dance-Off between the Big Bitty City Dance Team and the Berry Bitty City Dancers. Plum is stressed out and frazzled because she desperately wants to win. And the Big Bitty City Dancers are a force to be reckoned with. They are elegant and beautifully synchronized. Plum shows the girls a maze of dance steps that she's choreographed in the hopes of creating a winning piece. The problem is, the contest is only 1 week away!

The girls are all gathered at the café. Strawberry is experimenting making applesauce from scratch with a mallet (and making a mess) while the rest busily make their own wrapping paper and bows for the annual gift exchange they hold in celebration of First Frost. Mr. Longface stops by and Strawberry offers him some fresh applesauce but he declines, as he doesn't care for it. He's only there for some tea and, being that he's new in town, doesn't know what the group is up to.
Raspberry is distraught when she suspects her friends have copied her design on her lantern for the "Glimmerberry Gathering".

While sipping cider in Strawberry's café, the girls muse about how they cannot wait for winter to arrive. They list the various traditions they love about the season but the one they all agree on is the Glimmerberry Ball. Strawberry mentions that she doesn't think the café can hold the party this year because of how the town has grown. The girls decide to split up and search for a new location.

Lemon is ecstatic. She races out of her salon and goes around to the other girls' houses proclaiming that she "did it!" and beckoning them to join her. They follow her back and are completely dazzled by her newest creation - Glamicures. They are brightly colored, jeweled manicures with tiny microchips inside that play songs when the wearer moves her hand. Each girl lines up to receive her new glamicure and soon there is a cacophony of color and sound.

While working in her store, Orange overhears the Berrykins laughing and shouting outside. When she goes to the door to investigate, a clump of dandelion fluff gets blown inside chased by three Berrykins. She watches as they head butt the clump around until it floats back toward Orange. Just as it floats close, she gives it a bat sending it outside and the Berrykins happily chasing after it. Wanting in on the fun, she joins them.

While enjoying lunch in the café, the girls are interrupted by some music coming from the gazebo. They head outside and find Sadiebug and Kadiebug wearing badges and standing by a banner and podium. A group of chairs are set up in front of them. The twins begin to announce, and then argue, that they are starting a club - a good citizens club. The girls are shocked as the twins argue with each other all the time.

With all the Baby Berrykins running around Berry Bitty City, Princess Berrykin decides to build a Day Care Center and playground. But she's worried because it's dull-looking - all grey metal and brown wood. She asks Strawberry whom might be good to help her out. And two names immediately come to her mind - Lemon and Raspberry! The Princess confesses she's always admired their sense of design and style.

Toxicology: While drugs can cure disease and ease pain, they can also be agents of murder. Toxicologists can examine blood and tissue to uncover cases where death is not as natural as it may seemfrom slow arsenic poisoning to quick cocaine overdoses.

Investigators are always on the cutting edge of new forensic techniques that can help them solve cases more accurately. An experimental brain fingerprinting technique has already won the acquittal of a police officer accused of a drug charge.

A good coroner provides what's necessary to solve a crime. A bad one can spoil an otherwise rock-solid case. Cyril Wecht and Henry Lee, two of the country's most respected coroners, share their cases and insights into crime solving.
Missing Person: Approximately 1.8 million Americans are reported missing each year. Worldwide, the number of missing persons nearly triples.
The forces of nature can reduce a body to bones in a matter of weeks. Using a unique combination of art and science, forensic anthropologists give victims a face long after they have been forgotten.

Sometimes killers are careful to leave no fingerprints behind. But methods of the murder itself can leave a lasting impression on police, especially when the tools (or weapons) of a killer's trade leave an innocent victim marked for death.

While on a boating trip, Scott Carey (Grant Williams) is exposed to a radioactive cloud. Nothing seems amiss at first, but several months later Scott realizes that he's shrunk in height by several inches. He sees a doctor, who admits that he's baffled. As Scott continues to shrink, decreasing to three feet tall, he becomes bitter, and lashes out at his wife, Louise (Randy Stuart). He begins to fear a cure will never be found -- since even as he becomes a national sensation, he's still shrinking.

While researching a new drug, Dr. Jack Griffin (Claude Rains) stumbles on a potion that can make him invisible. When he reveals his new ability to his old mentor (Henry Travers) and his fiancée (Gloria Stuart), it's clear that a side effect of the potion is insanity. Jack goes on a violent rampage, and the police struggle to hunt him down, unable to see their target, while his mentor and his former partner (William Harrigan) desperately try to devise a plan to capture him.

Wrongly accused of murdering his brother, Geoffrey Radcliffe (Vincent Price) is found guilty and sentenced to die. But when sympathetic Dr. Griffin (John Sutton) injects him with a serum that renders him invisible, Radcliffe is able to escape and search for the real culprit. With Inspector Sampson (Cecil Kellaway) of Scotland Yard hot on his trail, Radcliffe begins to suspect that a recent hire in his family's mining company might have the answers he seeks.
A criminal (Jon Hall) haunts his enemies' mansion after a mad scientist (John Carradine) makes him invisible.
A scientist (Bela Lugosi) seeks an antidote for a radium-poisoned colleague (Boris Karloff) with the touch of death.

Caroline Ellis (Kate Hudson), a good-natured nurse living in New Orleans, quits her job at a hospice to work for Violet Devereaux (Gena Rowlands), an elderly woman whose husband, Ben (John Hurt), is in poor health following a stroke. When Caroline begins to explore the couple's rundown Bayou mansion, she discovers strange artifacts and learns the house has a mysterious past. As she continues to investigate, she realizes that Violet is keeping a sinister secret about the cause of Ben's illness.

programmes.t: The Last House on the Left
programmes.d: Mari and her friend look forward to a holiday at the remote Collingwood lake house, but instead an escaped convict (Garret Dillahunt) and his crew kidnap them and later leave them for dead. Mari makes her way back home, where her parents, John (Tony Goldwyn) and Emma (Monica Potter), have unwittingly offered shelter to the thugs. When John and Emma find out what happened to their daughter, they decide to make the strangers rue the day they harmed Mari.

A team of space marines known as the Rapid Response Tactical Squad, led by Sarge (Karl Urban), is sent to a science facility on Mars after somebody reports a security breach. There, they learn that the alert came after a test subject, a mass murderer purposefully injected with alien DNA, broke free and began killing people. Dr. Grimm (Rosamund Pike), who is related to team member Reaper (The Rock), informs them all that the chromosome can mutate humans into monsters -- and is highly infectious.

Queen Ravenna (Charlize Theron), who seized control of her kingdom by marrying and killing its rightful ruler, needs the life force of young maidens to maintain her beauty. However, to become truly immortal, Ravenna must consume the heart of her stepdaughter Snow White (Kristen Stewart). Snow escapes, and Ravenna dispatches a huntsman (Chris Hemsworth) to capture her. But Snow, the Huntsman and a rebel army join forces to destroy Ravenna and restore the balance of life and death.

The Collectors now control the Commonwealth and put the Andromeda crew on trial.
Andromeda discovers a shipment of bio-armor, with terrifying results.

The Abyss kills Beka's friend, and the crew must figure out what information they killed for.
Andromeda rescues a ship returning from peace talks with the Magog. An attack is coming.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Nijimura Brothers, Part 1
programmes.d: Josuke and Jotaro learn that a man with a bow and arrow was responsible for awakening Angelo’s Stand ability. Realizing the town is still in danger, they decide to find the bow and arrow before it can create any more victims.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Nijimura Brothers, Part 2
programmes.d: Josuke enters the Nijimura Brothers’ house to rescue Koichi, who is in critical condition after getting shot by Keicho Nijimura’s bow and arrow. But when Josuke steps into the house, he is attacked by Keicho’s Stand.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Nijimura Brothers, Part 3
programmes.d: After defeating Keicho, Koichi insists they find the bow and arrow and destroy it. Josuke agrees, but when the two enter the attic where the bow and arrow are being kept, they hear an inhuman noise inside.

On his way to school, Koichi finds himself blackmailed by a man named Tamami Kobayashi, who frames him for running over a cat. A panicked Koichi starts to feel guilty for his actions when suddenly a giant lock appears on his chest!

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Toshikazu Hazamada (Show Off)
programmes.d: Josuke and Koichi get info that a student at their school, Toshikazu Hazamada may be a Stand user and decide to look into the case. Their suspicions are quickly confirmed after Hazamada’s wooden doll morphs into an exact copy of Josuke and attacks them.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Yukako Yamagishi Falls in Love, Part 1
programmes.st: Yukako Yamagishi Falls in Love, Part 1
programmes.d: Koichi is both surprised and excited when a girl named Yukako Yamagishi says she likes him. But Koichi’s joy quickly turns into fear after Yukako begins to express her love for him in very erratic and dangerous ways.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Yukako Yamagishi Falls in Love, Part 2
programmes.st: Yukako Yamagishi Falls in Love, Part 2
programmes.d: Yukako’s dangerous obsession with reshaping Koichi into a man fit for her gets worse, prompting Koichi to hatch an escape plan. He tries to call Josuke for help using a nearby pay phone but is stopped by Yukako, who anticipated his move.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Let’s Go Eat Some Italian Food
programmes.st: Let’s Go Eat Some Italian Food
programmes.d: Josuke and Okuyasu come across an Italian restaurant owned by an Italian chef named Tonio. When Okuyasu asks for the menu, Tonio explains that he decides the menu on the spot based on the customer he sees.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Chili Pepper, Part 1
programmes.d: Chili Pepper suddenly appears before Josuke to test his Stand powers. Josuke puts up a fight but is overwhelmed by Chili Pepper’s power. The next day, Josuke and friends learn from Jotaro that a man who can locate Chili Pepper is heading to Morioh

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Chili Pepper, Part 2
programmes.d: Josuke and his friends gather at the Port to try and reach Joseph Joestar before Chili Pepper. Speculating the enemy is hiding nearby, Jotaro orders Josuke and Koichi to stay behind and find Chili Pepper’s user while he and Okuyasu go protect Joseph.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: We Picked Up Something Crazy!
programmes.d: With Akira Otoishi arrested and the bow and arrow safely recovered, peace seemingly returns to Morioh. But Josuke’s life is far from peaceful as he struggles to deal with his father, whose old age is making things difficult for them to bond.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Let's Go to the Manga Artist's House, Part 1
programmes.st: Let's Go to the Manga Artist's House, Part 1
programmes.d: Koichi and Hazamada visit the home of Rohan Kishibe, a popular manga artist whom they are huge fans of. Much to their joy, Rohan not only agrees to sign autographs but also invites them to take a tour of his workspace.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Let's Go to the Manga Artist's House, Part 2
programmes.st: Let's Go to the Manga Artist's House, Part 2
programmes.d: Koichi is drawn back to Rohan’s house, where he sees the manga artist finishing up his next manga at an incredible speed. Rohan uses his stand Heaven’s Door on Koichi again to gain further creative inspiration from the young boy’s life experience.

programmes.st: David Harper and Hettie Jago, Day 5

programmes.st: Natasha Raskin Sharp and Ishy Khan, Day 1
programmes.d: Natasha Raskin Sharp and Ishy Khan start their trip in Northumberland. Natasha is drawn to a whimsical 19th century French candelabrum, while Ishy makes friends with a family of teddies and the cutest Jack Russell ever.

programmes.st: Natasha Raskin Sharp and Ishy Khan, Day 2
programmes.d: In North Yorkshire, Natasha Raskin Sharp finds a satirical Georgian caricature and a George III silver cream jug. Ishy Khan buys a dainty Victorian love heart watch key, some Persian salt bags and a glass terrarium.

programmes.st: Natasha Raskin Sharp and Ishy Khan, Day 3
programmes.d: In East Yorkshire, Natasha Raskin Sharp puts on the ritz with a 1920s flapper dress and snaps up a Scottish Arts and Crafts potpourri bowl and more. Ishy Khan picks up a glass inkwell shaped like a terrier, and antique prayer mat and more.

programmes.st: Natasha Raskin Sharp and Ishy Khan, Day 4
programmes.d: In West Yorkshire, Natasha Raskin Sharp collects some Georg Jensen christening cutlery, and Robert "Mouseman" Thompson cheeseboard, and some antique jugs. Meanwhile, Ishy Khan invests in a beautiful Art Nouveau charger.

programmes.st: Natasha Raskin Sharp and Ishy Khan, Day 5
programmes.d: In the East Midlands, Natasha Raskin Sharp picks up a 17th century map of Nottinghamshire and a Victorian reception bell, while Ishy Khan eyes an optician's antique stock and a Victorian prayer chair. Who will be triumphant?

programmes.st: Catherine Southon and Phil Serrell, Day 1
programmes.d: Catherine Southon and Phil Serrell set off from Bristol in a little red Morgan Roadster. On their first day, they amass a variety of treasures, including a vintage florist's stand, tiles, a vintage French wine map and more.

programmes.st: Catherine Southon and Phil Serrell, Day 2
programmes.d: It's an eclectic mix of bargain buys today. Catherine Southon eyes a jardinière, motoring vanity set, streetlamp and an art Deco cocktail glass numbering set. Phil Serrell pursues an antique adjustable bookcase and a flag.

programmes.st: Catherine Southon and Phil Serrell, Day 3

Banker Milburn 'Drysdale's precocious 11-year-old nephew swindles the hillbillies of all the valuable art objects in their mansion.

When Crowfoot Indians come to Beverly Hills to discuss a boundary dispute at the Clampett oil field, Granny prepares for war.

Hospitalized for nerves from dealing with the hillbillies Mrs. Drysdale threatens Mr. Drysdale to stay there until he gets rid of them and even sending for a specialist. Unfortunately, the Clampet clan is on their way to visit her.

Bill ends his pursuit of one mystery, but then another one presents itself; Naomi fears she and Jacob may have hit a tipping point in their marriage; and Hayley enacts a new plan to get what her heart truly desires.
After an unpleasant encounter with Leslie, Nicole delivers an apology to Anita; Vanessa has a challenge for Joey; and sparks fly when Eva meets a strikingly handsome newcomer.

Kat is consumed with guilt after a passionate night with Tomas leaves him in a great deal of pain; Smitty and Martin bask in their new normal; June doles out advice to Tyrell; and Hayley embarks on a lucrative fact-finding mission.

Dani has an update for Ridge Forrester (Thorsten Kaye, THE BOLD AND THE BEAUTIFUL); Joey has a twisted yet interesting proposition for one of the Duprees; Donnell and Vanessa clash over his future; Jacob has a startling run-in; and Chelsea takes matter...

Joseph "Joe" Kennedy's political ambition passes to reluctant son Jack.

Catherine violates department protocol when she takes the case of a rape accusation against her ex-husband. Warrick and Sara search for the missing bullet that will either exonerate or indict a cop for murder.
When a teenager and her sister are the sole survivors of the gruesome murder of four members of one family in a quiet suburban neighborhood, Grissom and his entire team investigate the crime.

Royce Harmon was murdered 3 months ago in a scene staged to look like a suicide. Now another murder has taken place. Whoever the killer is he has a thorough knowledge of forensics, he purposefully has left evidence, and has baffled Grissom and his team.
Grissom and his team investigate the death of a first class passenger on a flight to Las Vegas.
Grissom and Sara investigate a bug riddled body found in the desert. Warrick and Catherine look into the theft of some valuable art.
A woman is abducted from a supermarket. In the store, Grissom finds a bathroom stall door that claims five women have been killed.
A man about to go on trial for arson and the murder of his wife and child seeks assistance from Grissom to help prove his innocence.
A bomb goes off in an office building, killing one and injuring many more. The chief suspect is a security guard who left minutes before the explosion and has knowledge in bomb making.
When a single human bone is discovered in the desert, Grissom and Catherine must cover miles of territory to find the rest of the skeleton.
At a swanky fundraiser, attended by the sheriff, a woman turns up dead in the pool.
A woman is abducted from a mall parking garage. She's raped, beaten, shot and left for dead. Sara collects evidence from her and grows attached to her.
A body is found in a pottery store in what's apparently a robbery that was interrupted.
A couple leaving a restaurant on their anniversary are killed in the street and their car is stolen. The crime scene is compromised when it rains shortly after the CSIs arrive.
The entire team investigates the abduction of the infant child of a well-to-do family. Suspicion immediately falls on the child's parents.
Two teenage girls run over a deaf man with their car, but they didn't kill him - he was already dead.
Grissom, Nick, and Warrick take the case of a jogger who was killed by a wild animal in the park. It gets complicated when they discover that the jogger had his liver removed after he was killed.
On the day Grissom has to evaluate his team, a head is found in the trunk of a car. While Gil and Catherine work on the head, Sara and Nick investigate a body in the desert that's missing its head.
When an entire family disappears into thin air, Horatio vows to find them, dead or alive.
The CSIs expose the seedy underbelly of children’s beauty pageants when a contestant's mom is murdered.
An eccentric genius is assassinated with the most unique weapon the CSIs have ever seen.
When a skydiver is murdered, the CSIs discover that he has more than 100 children and all of them are suspects.
When the sisters of a Miami sorority are knocked off one by one, the CSIs try to end the murder spree.
When a neighborhood do-gooder is murdered, Horatio and the CSIs discover that he was planning to blow the whistle on something big.
When the Miami Taunter kills again, Horatio comes face-to-face with the matriarch of the suspected killer's family, who may or may not help his investigation.
When a beloved tennis coach is nearly killed, Calleigh discovers a personal connection to the case.
Horatio uncovers a corruption scandal that pits him against an old adversary, and Calleigh makes a life-changing decision.
When one of the CSI's biggest enemies is murdered, Horatio must determine which of his team members is a suspect.
The CSI team suffers the tragic loss of one of their own when a psychotic genius runs wild in otherwise beautiful Miami.
When a bottle girl is murdered at an exclusive club, Horatio must search through Miami's most elite guest list to find her killer.
A young girl is kidnapped and the CSIs' only witness is a blind man, who heard the abduction, leading Horatio to an old nemesis.
When the killer of Horatio's wife busts out of prison and goes on a rampage, they must determine what he's after and find him before he strikes again.
When a reality star is murdered, the CSIs investigate the cast, the obsessed fans, and the stars' hidden pasts to find the killer.
When a man claims to have dreamed of a murder before it happened, Horatio must send Natalia undercover for the team to determine the truth.
When a sugar refinery explodes, Horatio Caine and the CSI team make a shocking discovery about one of the factory's employees.
When four victims are found dead in a hotel room and the main suspect turns up wielding an ax, the CSIs try to piece together the details.
When two young journalists are found dead on the eve of St. Patrick's Day, the CSIs try to find the clue at the end of the rainbow.
When a woman is found dead, the evidence and autopsy both suggest suicide, but Stella is unconvinced and risks her life to pursue the case.
A death row inmate's final request brings Hawkes to a Pennsylvania prison and face-to-face with a personal secret just as a prison riot erupts.
The shooting of a 14-year-old boy in front of his 12-year-old brother takes Detective Mac Taylor’s drive for justice to another level.
When a slab of concrete starts bleeding in midtown, the CSIs' investigation takes them into an underground world of hardcore fighting.
After being injured, Mac watches his neighbors while recuperating and witnesses mysterious activity that leads to murder.
The CSI New York team of investigators follows a trail left by Shane Casey and realizes he is targeting a vacationing Danny out of revenge.
The newest CSI New York team of investigators’ team members is welcomed by stumbling upon a woman murdered in the NYPD crime lab building.
When a young woman appears to be strangled while in a live online chat that Adam witnesses the CSIs must determine if it was real or a hoax.
When a couple is found beaten in their home, the CSIs think they have the suspect after a mother ID's her son, but all is not what it seems.
When a powerful gang leader is murdered, the CSI New York team of investigators must find the killer before a street war breaks out.
A jewel heist at the penthouse of one of New York's most powerful attorneys takes a bizarre turn as the case leads the CSIs to a man in the morgue.
The CSI New York team of investigators finds a body on a rooftop and must find the killer who is manipulating crime scenes.
With a sniper lose in New York City, Mac must relive an abduction case that might have created one of the city's deadliest foes.
The CSI New York team of investigators experience eerie occurrences after a woman is found who has literally been scared to death.
Mac goes up against the deputy chief of detectives when a dark secret from the chief's past threatens his reputation and family.
Kali Armstrong steps up to Jaida Parker to prove who's the baddest in NXT.

The family manages to collect $30 in the family pot and an argument ensues when Edith wants to use the money to set her lyrics for a song to music. Meanwhile, Archie is disturbed by robberies in the neighborhood and wants to use the money to buy a gun.

programmes.d: Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a program for two pianos comprising works of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, Maurice Ravel, Anton Arensky, Sergei Rachmaninoff and Nikolai Kapustin.
Testimony about the growth of larvae in dead bodies helps convict the man who stabbed a couple to death and strangled their 4-year-old daughter in 1993.

Police reopen a rape-murder case 25 years after the crime and find enough DNA evidence to bring him to justice. And a confession made to a "Baywatch" TV star helps police solve the three-year-old riddle of a wealthy Newport Beach woman's murder.
In Missouri, a part-time missionary is convicted, 38 years later, of killing her 5-year-old stepdaughter, and the skeleton of a Michigan boy, dead for 10 years, leads police to a serial killer.

When a deadly house fire claims the life of a family in rural Oklahoma, investigators suspect foul play and it sends a mother on a decades-long crusade to find out what happened to her missing teenage daughter and best friend.

A kidnapper grabs 8-year-old Chad Choice from his home in Texas, then torments his parents with two ransom demands. The case goes cold until the parents receive a chilling package in the mail that contains a letter--and a skull.
A look at the case of James Allen Selby, a serial rapist who eluded police for years while attacking 11 women in five states - Oklahoma, Nevada, California, Arizona, and Colorado.

The killing of a woman in a VA goes unsolved for a quarter of a century before investigators are finally able to zero in on the likely killer. And, in 1999 detectives test the blood evidence and develop a DNA profile of a shooting death from 1980.
A woman's fall from a cliff in the Grand Canyon leads police to uncover a series of grisly murders, and investigators smoke out a killer when they find crucial DNA evidence on his cigarette butts.
Halloween in a small town is canceled indefinitely when a young girl is kidnapped and killed on her way home from a costume party.

programmes.st: In The Care Of A Killer/Deadly Lies
programmes.d: The suspicious death of 2-year-old Billy Blankenship is solved when police force his babysitter to re-enact the circumstances of his death. Then, a murder case is solved when the dead man's body is accidentally found by divers.

A serial rapist seals his own fate when he sends a taunting letter to police. And when a man is found dead in South Dakota, his head bashed in by a 50-pound rock, investigators go on a 20-year search for the killers.
College student Brad Perry shows up to work his graveyard shift at the gas station and is never seen alive again.
When 25-year-old school teacher Christy Mirack is found murdered in her apartment in 1992, there is no shortage of suspects.

Just two years into their marriage, Chuck and Cheryl Hall are torn apart when Chuck finds Cheryl murdered. Though Cheryl's family is certain they know her killer, the law isn't as sure. After several decades, a DNA match erases all doubt.
A fire in January 2007 claims the life of WWII vet Bennie Angelo. A closer look at the crime scene reveals Bennie was dead before the fire, bumping an arson case up to homicide.

When 36-year-old computer programmer Lisa Valdez fails to show up for work, her apartment manager finds her brutally murdered. Detectives ask, could she be the victim of a brutal serial killer? Or was Lisa murdered by someone she knew?

A forensic dentist helps police nab a child killer by showing that the teeth marks on the killer's arms match the teeth of the murdered boy. And telltale blood stains on a blue bandana solve the 10-year-old case of a teenage girl murdered.
A fancy new bag gives Abbi confidence during unemployment. Ilana and Jaimé deal with an inevitable New York City nightmare: bedbugs.
The girls' "Friendiversary" celebration takes a turn for the dangerous when they witness something horrible.
Sarah enters a girl into a pageant, and Steve's rude behavior in a police car has consequences.

programmes.st: The Sarah Silverman Program Bored of the Rings
programmes.d: Sarah accidentally becomes a radical anti-abortion group's most passionate recruit, and a Dungeons & Dragons game interrupts Brian and Steve's date.
When the guys have to pass a drug test at work, they only have one choice: bribe middle school kids for clean urine.
Rumors of a possible promotion spread at work and test the guys' allegiances as they all vie for the new job.
The guys will stop at nothing to get tickets to a sold-out basketball game, even if it means being dunked in a horchata tank and seeing a grown man's penis.
While their house is being fumigated, the guys decide to crash at the office and do a bunch of drugs, but their campout is threatened when two burglars break into the office.
To prevent Jillian from attending an important business function, the guys send her on a blind date, resulting in a rescue operation at an Insane Clown Posse concert.
When Alice won't give the guys time off for a fake holiday called Half-Christmas, they decide to go on strike for better benefits.
Mr. Garvey clashes with students over club photos, and President Obama addresses the NSA scandal.
Two women prepare to fight outside a club, and the Valets wonder why people mess with the Batmans.
Two slaves try to find a way out of fighting to the death, and a member of a Latin gang proves his toughness.
A passenger finds out that he's far from the first to board, and some breakdancers keep it nooice.

Episode 4 includes Late Night with Butt-Head, Pool Toys, The Final Judgement of Beavis, Right On, and Date Bait, handpicked by Mike Judge himself.
Episode 5 includes Butt Is It Art?, Figure Drawing, Mr. Anderson's Balls, Teen Talk, and Manners Suck, handpicked by Mike Judge himself.
Episode 6 includes The Pipe of Doom, Safe Driving, Liar! Liar!, and Generation in Crisis, handpicked by Mike Judge himself.
Episode 7 includes Beavis and Butt-Head Vs. the Vending Machine, Radio Sweethearts, The Great Cornholio, and Held Back, handpicked by Mike Judge himself.
Nathan makes use of parody law to open up a coffee shop nearly identical to Starbucks in its branding and appearance.
Nathan comes up with a way to get a failing taxi company some much-needed press and implements a risky new line-cutting policy at a hot dog stand.
When Tim's dad returns from the psychiatric hospital, the guys find themselves reduced to junior status at Cramblin Duvet.
The guys become wracked with guilt after running into Carter Grant at the local advertising awards ceremony.
Garcia and Junior help build a wall to keep Mexicans from crossing into America illegally.
Junior finds a job he really wants: commissioner for animal carcass removal.
While the deputies investigate Reno's Thai sex trade, Wiegel's long-lost father returns to reconnect with his daughter.
Strong Sister magazine visits the station for an in-depth profile on Williams, and the deputies enforce Reno's six-foot rule for lap dances.
Stan and kyle are psyched to have Wendy and Bebe visit their clubhouse for a game of Truth or Dare, but first, they have to build one.
South Park's 14th Annual "Cow Days" rodeo and carnival is here and the boys are determined to win Terrance and Phillip dolls.
After a huge loss in court, Chef is left penniless, but he has some very famous and talented friends in the music business who want to help their old mentor.
When Sharon Marsh's Aunt Flo makes a monthly visit, she brings a mysterious pet fish for Stan.
Dinner with Cartman's family takes a bizarre twist when Uncle Howard shows up after breaking out of prison with the help of his cellmate, Charlie Manson.

programmes.st: Terror in the Tar Heel State
programmes.d: Friends are baffled when a vivacious FBI secretary is suddenly murdered.
An heiress's fiery relationship comes to a violent and shocking end.
A Virginia couple's blissful retirement ends with a horrifying twist.
A gentle soul's little slice of heaven becomes a living hell.
Two friends become murder suspects in Louisiana.
A beautiful co-ed's murder ignites a search for a diabolical serial killer.
A South Carolina town is rocked by the murder of a prominent attorney.
A gang of outlaws wreaks havoc on small towns throughout Appalachia.
A corrupt Georgia sheriff resorts to murder to hold on to his job.
Two young women mysteriously disappear 13 years apart in Louisiana.
Police investigate a series of murders in Georgia and South Carolina.
A prim and proper Alabama debutante turns into a black widow.
Women start disappearing after a smooth-talking cowboy comes to town.
A devoted mother is found dead after a hurricane in coastal Alabama.
A down-on-his-luck Southern gentleman turns into a murderous monster.
One crazy night turns a couple's dream life into a perfect nightmare.
Fear spreads through a small Kentucky town after a family is murdered
A Long Island newlywed disappears on Christmas Eve.
A community is shocked when one of it's richest residents is gunned down.
The team investigates an unsub with striking similarities to "The Chameleon."
When the BAU is called to Salt Lake City Utah to investigate a triple homicide, the search for a connection among the victims could lead them to a fugitive who could have ties to the UnSub.
The BAU investigates when several young men and women are victims of disfiguring acid attacks. Also, Dr. Reid begins to settle into his new surroundings. (TV-14 D, L, V)

The BAU heads south to investigate a fast-moving UnSub whose signature matches that of a serial killer from 30 years ago. Also, the team learns that someone is tracking their cases and replicating crimes the BAU is solving.
As the BAU wraps up an investigation into unusual stabbings in Upstate New York, Morgan's visit with one of the crime's survivors could uncover more questions left for the team to answer.
A series of targeted kidnappings near Memphis have the BAU searching for a commonality between the missing persons and a motive to lead to the UnSub.
When the BAU investigates victims of possible ritualistic murders in Utah, clues lead them to believe that the UnSub they are looking for might have a fascination with the Salem Witch Trials.

When three bodies are found with animal and human bite marks in a shallow grave near Milwaukee, the BAU has puzzling questions to answer. Meanwhile, Reid and Garcia work out for a company fitness test, but try to hide their preparation from Morgan.
The BAU travel to Rapid City after two male victims are discovered murdered in a ritualistic manner. Also, Reid continues to grieve over Maeve's death.
When a family of four is abducted while on vacation in Barbados, the BAU is called to assist Unit Chief Jack Garrett (Gary Sinise) and his International Unit on their investigation.
The BAU team is called in to investigate when male victims are found with no way to identify them. (TV-14 L, V)
When a woman is murdered in a small town in Florida, the BAU faces a community full of suspects. Also, Lewis receives a career opportunity that may take her away from the BAU.
When an UnSub in Miami sensationalizes his crimes by giving the local media exclusive footage, the BAU is called in to investigate.
The team races to find a connection between two families, one murdered and the other abducted.
The BAU team travels to Illinois to investigate what appears to be a copycat serial killer.

The Centers for Disease Control calls on the BAU when they suspect bioterrorism is behind a series of mysterious deaths in Virginia. Also, Garcia visits her stepbrother, Carlos (Sebastian Sozzi), to take care of a difficult family issue. (TV-14 L, V)

When two murder victims are found in a backwoods community in West Virginia, the BAU uncovers a long-simmering feud between two families and must investigate which side could be responsible for the deaths.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: The veterans finally enter the audition process. Now all 83 women are judged head to head during a panel interview, a solo dance performance and on their appearance on the football field as seen and the big screen.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: 44 women begin the very first training camp at the new 1 billion dollar Cowboys' facility, The Star.  At the First Meeting, Kelli lays down the law and makes it clear that eight women will be sent home this summer.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: First, the ladies need to have the "classic look" of a Dallas Cowboys Cheerleader.  Kelli's hair and make-up transformations are legendary.  The ladies are also assessed through a new state of the art fitness test, "Styku".

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: Kelli media trains the rookie candidates to determine who best represents the DCC at press events.  NBC news anchor, Meredith Land tests their on-camera interview skills.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: Personality is critical when representing the DCC brand.  Kelli takes the women on location to see how they interact during a public appearance.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: Katy Perry's choreographer, Nick Florez, stops by to offer some performance advice to the ladies.  A day that each cheerleader never forgets.  The first time they wear the DCC uniform to pose for their cameo photos.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: The squad goes on an appearance to support pop music star, Demi Lovato. The ladies learn the entrance to the famed pre-game dance.  It's a make or break moment.  If a woman can't learn it quickly it might be her last night.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: With two suspended vets, the team must re-block their formations for their Hall Of Fame performance.   New vets step up as a new point of the triangle is named.  The rookie candidates try to get their footing during this never seen before rehearsal.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: 23 veterans travel to Canton, Ohio to perform at Jerry Jones' induction to the Pro Football Hall of Fame.  All eyes are watching as the DCC perform for the NFL elite.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: As training camp winds down the pressure skyrockets.  No one wants to be sent home now.  The ladies start to crack under the pressure.  Another one is sent home.  Will this be the final cut?

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: Kelli announces the official squad and the women realize the hard-fought dream of becoming a Dallas Cowboys Cheerleader.  Full of excitement and nerves, the squad prepares for their very first football game at AT&T Stadium.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.st: The Road to World Class Begins
programmes.d: Hundreds of eager hopefuls -- ranging from starry-eyed rookies to experienced NFL cheerleaders -- gather at AT&T Stadium for a shot at joining the world's most famous squad.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: The 125 remaining hopefuls must nail a choreographed routine before advancing to the final rounds, and the DCC veterans reveal their plans for the future.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.st: Leave It All on the Dance Floor
programmes.d: A former Laker Girl who survived the Las Vegas shooting chases her dream, and the women work on their solo presentations and interviews as finals approach.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: The returning veterans travel to the Bahamas to shoot the Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders swimsuit calendar, and the rookies feel the pressure as training camp begins.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: The first-year hopefuls get new looks on Rookie Makeover Day, DCC alumni give the candidates feedback, and Cowboys' Head Coach Jason Garrett stops by during a rehearsal.

programmes.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders: Making the Team
programmes.d: Before Kelli and Judy make roster cuts, the rookies learn the famed kickline and jump splits, get fitted for the iconic uniform and face Jay Johnson's power squad training.

Jerry Springer hosts as daters decide how much emotional "baggage" they are willing to put up with when finding love. A dater must choose between women whose baggage includes eating chalk and insisting her man wears lipstick.
Two families, both whom have never met, have agreed that the Wives will swap homes, children and husbands for two weeks to see what they can learn from their own lives.
Wioletta who lives on benefits with her family swaps places with Suzanne who pays for her children to have music lessons.
This week the Gelden and Browse family's wives swap places.
Emma Payne who stays home as a full time mother swaps places with sweetshop owner Sam Zendel-Ellis.

programmes.t: I Love New York: Let's Do It Again
programmes.d: New York must eliminate 5 men, but it's not that easy. At a pre-elimination cocktail party, things heat up as the men drink too much, fight and even bribe others to win over New York.

programmes.t: I Love New York: Flowers from Fishburne
programmes.d: Now down to 15 men, New York invites the guys to a pond where they must prove their love by swimming to her and presenting her with a gift.

programmes.t: I Love New York: The Stolen Date
programmes.d: With 12 guys left, some of the boys play a prank on a few of the less popular men that keeps them up all night.

programmes.t: I Love New York: Nobody Likes a Snitch
programmes.d: New York has barely wiped the morning out of her eyes when a fight breaks out between two of her boys. Although NY can be a tolerant person, violence is non-negotiable and she is faced with the tough decision to let a guy go.

programmes.t: I Love New York: Blood Oath Gone Bad
programmes.d: After snitching, fighting, and spitting, and nearly getting eliminated, one man is the house enemy and anxiously waits for an opportunity to redeem himself.
New York surprises the guys with the return of one man. Another man is unhappy as his world is suddenly turned upside down and he literally fears for his life.

programmes.t: I Love New York: I Still Have Love for New York
programmes.st: I Still Have Love for New York
programmes.d: New York invites the remaining six guys' exes to the house and this time, there's a special twist involved. She's bringing two of HER exes, Chance and Real, to help dig up some dirt on her guys.

programmes.t: I Love New York: Mind Games
programmes.d: With 5 guys left, New York wants to find out who's the most compatible with her and who's just plain crazy, when she takes the boys for a psych test.

programmes.t: I Love New York: Meet the Parents
programmes.d: With only four guys left, it's time to clean house, literally. New York has invited some special guests-the guy's parents, so she gets her boys to scour and scrub her house for their arrival.

programmes.t: I Love New York: Miami Thrice
programmes.d: After the last elimination, New York tells her final three men to pack their bags because they're heading to Miami!

programmes.t: I Love New York: Clip Show
programmes.d: In this 30-minute special episode, NY hosts a look back at hilarious, never-before-seen moments with our favorite guys from the series.

programmes.t: I Love New York: Rasta Finale
programmes.d: After a season of ups and downs and a tense elimination in Miami, it's down to New York's final two suitors. They accompany New York to the tropics of Jamaica for the final showdown.

Personal grievances get in the way of detective Harry Trumble's retirement party. Trumble never forgave Dr. Sloan for marrying his college sweetheart and dedicated his life to his work.

Dr. Sloan treats Amanda and Jesse to lunch to acknowledge Amanda's medical examiner investigation award. Unfortunately, their festivities are interrupted when a young man collapses in the hotel restaurant wearing only a bathrobe.
A serial killer is on the loose at Community General, targeting both patients and doctors. Dr. Sloan, Steve, Amanda, and Jesse notice that a murder takes place every hour on the hour.

Jesse witnesses a car accident and rushes to help the beautiful victim, Chloe Marsden, who has stopped breathing. After a quick application of CPR, Chloe is revived and finds Jesse accompanying her to the hospital.

To Steve, Jesse, and Amanda's embarrassment, Dr. Sloan rehearses with a swing band at BBQ Bob's as he prepares for a benefit dance for the children's unit at the hospital. But the mood quickly transforms into a tone of horror.
Steve meets up with his young protégé, Tommy Allen, but is ready to strangle him when he finds out that Tommy was involved in another brawl, this time at BBQ Bob's!
A ratings war sparks a wave of deaths across the big TV networks - a magician impales himself on a bed of spikes, and Dr Danger also turns up dead.
With the latest murder on TV taking place at Community General, Dr. Sloan, Steve, Jesse, and Amanda prepare to solve this case and protect their integrity.

Steve assigns Amy Devlin and Taylor Lucas, two police officers from the Vice Squad, to assist in solving the homicide of local pimp Milton Wilder. However, Taylor convinces her partner to take a temporary detour on their way to the investigation.

programmes.st: Today Is The Last Day Of The Rest Of My Life
programmes.d: The new attending physician, Kate Delibe, is causing a stir at Community General with her unorthodox methods of care. Delibe assists terminally ill patient George Dugan's suicide against Dr. Sloan's wishes.
As Lou Summers heads to the comedy club to host Mark's Man of the Year Roast, a driver in a nearby car shoots at him and misses, but Lou doesn't hear it because his hearing aids aren't on.

Dr. Mark Sloan is caught between family and professional loyalties as his brother Stacy, and medical student Daniel, are both implicated in a mysterious series of events that end in an accidental death.
Steve responds to a call where earlier a man chased another man out of a store with a gun.
When Dr. Wesley, Dean of the medical school, is arrested for sale of narcotics, she pleads her innocence to Mark. Meanwhile, Mark's student Quinn and neighbor Jennifer plan to marry.
While out on his morning jog, Jesse unsuccessfully attempts to save a man who has locked himself in his gargage with the engine running, an apparent suicide.
After Madison hears that Lisa, a personal friend and one of her star students, has missed a few classes, she visits her and finds Lisa comatose from a drug overdose.
It's a case of mistaken identity when Greg, a mobster who looks just like Mark, is released from prison and moves into Mark's neighborhood.

programmes.st: The Enemy of the World: Episode 2
programmes.d: The Doctor is informed by Astrid's boss, Kent, that the world is on the verge of domination by a charismatic scientist and politician named Salamander.

programmes.st: The Enemy of the World: Episode 3
programmes.d: The Doctor impersonates his lookalike, would-be dictator Salamander, to penetrate a research station controlled by Salamander's minions.

programmes.st: The Enemy of the World: Episode 4
programmes.d: Giles Kent is revealed to be a traitor, in league with would-be 21st century dictator Salamander; the Doctor infiltrates the dictator's research station.

programmes.st: The Enemy of the World: Episode 5
programmes.d: Traitorous scientist Kent has blown up the research station infiltrated by the Doctor; not long afterward, Salamander, who bears a startling resemblance to the Doctor, makes an appearance.

programmes.st: The Enemy of the World: Episode 6
programmes.d: Having been thwarted in his plans to rule the world, Salamander tries to make a quick getaway by posing as the Doctor. Manning the controls of the TARDIS, Salamander tries to escape.

The Doctor attempts to save his companions but instead finds himself imprisoned.

A Weimaraner eats everything in sight; a yellow Lab's excess energy is expressed destructively; an Australian shepherd is unable to socialize with other dogs.
Three canines with issues at a dog-friendly ad agency office; a border collie mix becomes excited and unresponsive to commands when in her owner's truck.
Velvet Revolver drummer Matt Sorum's French bulldog goes crazy at the sight of other dogs; Cesar helps a former therapy dog with aggression issues.
A woman who has relinquished the role of pack leader to her Welsh Sealyham terrier; an English mastiff with too much energy; a Tibetan terrier who is a terror on walks.
A Great Dane with an aggressive attitude; Cesar helps a shepherd mix recover from the issues developed while living in a hoarding situation so she can be rehomed.

programmes.st: How to Raise the Perfect Dog
programmes.d: Cesar adopts four puppies and films them living with him and his pack for their first eight months to demonstrate how to raise a balanced dog.

A is for armadillo, but where are the rest of the animals in the ABC book? They're missing! Dora and Boots jump into the giant alphabet book to help the little armadillo solve the mystery.

What do you want to be when you grow up? On today's adventure, Dora and Boots get to try all sorts of jobs—from a pilot to a chef to an archeologist. But what will Dora decide to be when she grows up?

Excited, Dora puts the Star Pocket on Backpack and Dora and Boots set off on their very first star catching adventure. Their educational journey will take them all the way to the Cloud Castle, as they try to rescue an adorable baby star.
Dora tells the story of how she first met Boots. On their very first adventure, Dora and Boots have to bring instruments back to the Fiesta Trio so they can play for the cranky Queen Bee.

Swiper swipes Dora's favorite necklace and flings it all the way to the top of Star Mountain! To get to the peak, Dora and Boots need to run up the Star Steps, climb up the Diamond, and make it through ice, wind and snow!
Swiper's invented a Super Swiping Machine and he's going to swipe Tico's birthday presents! Super Spies Dora and Boots to the rescue!
"Hola, hola!/ Hello, Hello!/ It's a great day for school/ You know!" Boots' music teacher, la maestra de música, needs to get to school in a hurry - but her bicycle is broken!
It's Dora's cousin Daisy's 15th birthday party, her quinceañera! But the party can't start without Dora and Boots - they need to teach everybody the mambo!
Dora's cousin Diego protects and defends all the animals in the rainforest. But in order to save a Baby Condor, Diego winds up trapped himself. And now he needs OUR help! ¡No te preocupes, Diego!
Oh no! Baby Jaguar's best friend, Baby Bear, is stuck on a ledge atop Bear Mountain - and the ledge is cracking! With Baby Jaguar leading the way, Dora, Boots and Diego race to the rescue!
Dora and Boots set out to help King Juan el Bobo find his crown so we can all go to his Mamí's birthday party. Where did the forgetful king put his crown?
Abuela gives Dora and Boots a present for Dora's new puppy, but they'll have to watch out for Swiper, who's got a bunch of new swiping tricks up his sleeves.

Dora has some really exciting news to tell us: Someone new is joining Dora's family! Someone who sleeps in a cradle, drinks from a bottle, wears diapers, and likes to be rocked to sleep. Can you guess who it is? That's right!
Oh, no! Dora left her music homework in Boots' room. It's a song in English and Spanish, and she needs Boots to bring it to her school so she can sing it to the class.

Dora's baby brother and sister just love bananas, but they also love stories! So Dora tells them a Super Babies story! The Super Babies have to get their bananas back from that Super Villain Swiper the Fox.

Dora and all her friends are at the Super Adventure Race! To win the race, they have to make it across the Troll's tricky Bridge, past the Volcano filled with gooey balls, over the giant Wall, and all the way to the finish line.
It's summertime, and Dora and Boots are having a blast at the beach. But suddenly, they encounter the strangest sight - a snowman in Summer? What's wrong with this picture? Oh, no!
Dora and Boots are hiking on Rainbow Rock when they come across a shy rainbow, Arco Iris, hiding behind a waterfall.
Dora and Boots are having a blast at the beach when all of a sudden they hear a call for help. It's a baby crab stuck in a net!
Dora and Boots are playing catch when they discover a lost baby fox. And he wants his mommy! Just then, Swiper shows up to swipe Boots' superball.

It's a bright, sunny morning, and Dora wants to say hello to her baby brother and sister. But when Dora gets to their room, she sees that the babies have climbed into their baby carriage and are heading for danger!

programmes.st: Dora and Diego to the Rescue!
programmes.d: It's a high-speed, around-the-world adventure as Dora and her cousin Diego chase after Boots, who's being carried off on his giant kite by a mighty wind. Dora and Diego need YOUR help as they cross the ocean.

It's Clean-Up the Beach Day, as Dora and Boots are cleaning up garbage when they find a Singing Clam, who tells them the story of Mariana the Mermaid.  Mariana lives in the Mermaid Kingdom at the bottom of the ocean.

All over the world, everyone's celebrating Friendship Day!  But when Swiper mistakenly swipes all the special glowing Friendship Bracelets, Dora needs to team up with him to bring them back to the Friendship Parades.

programmes.st: Dora's Dance to the Rescue - HOUR SPECIAL
programmes.d: Put on your dancing shoes, because Dora needs you to spin, shake wiggle, jump and clap with her as she tries to rescue Swiper the fox, who's been trapped inside a bottle by a mean dancing elf.
Dora and Boots are exploring in the forest when they discover the gate to Fairy-Tale Land and enter this magical place. But...there's a mean witch who lives in Fairy-Tale Land.
Yo ho ho! Dora and Boots and all their friends are putting on a pirate show today for their mommies and daddies.
Dora's twin brother and sister have been sick, and she wants to buy them a present to cheer them up. Way up on a toy store shelf, she finds a dusty Jack-in-the-Box.

It's Twins Day, and everyone's getting ready for the big Twins Day party at Play Park! Dora even has a surprise for her puppy Perrito. He has a twin too—a long-lost puppy brother he hasn't seen since they were babies.
Dr. Quinn and the townspeople excitedly welcome poet Walt Whitman to Colorado Springs until rumors about his personal life begin to circulate.
Horace attempts suicide after receiving the official divorce document from Myra.
Dr. Mike is scandalized by the new liberated lifestyle her sister has adopted as a suffragette.
Sully and Brian forge a true father-son bond.

Everyone but Michaela assumes that Sully is dead when he disappears after a fight with his nemesis, Sgt. O’Connor.
Sully struggles to survive in the wilderness as Dr. Mike desperately searches for him.
Dr. Mike hides Sully to protect him from the army who wanted to arrest him but believe he is dead.
Indian attacks continue in Colorado Springs as Hank names himself sheriff, determined to prove Sully is alive.
Dr. Mike, who believes she may be pregnant again, broods about Sully’s fate at the hands of the army.
Dr. Mike is dismayed when a Russian princess who claims to be a psychic mesmerizes the town.
Dr. Mike must help Grace and Robert E. realize that their adopted son may die from his mysterious illness.
Dr. Mike’s sister returns to town to champion prohibition, just as Jake’s self-doubts about Teresa send him on an uncontrollable drinking spree.
Dr. Mike risks her life to battle a deadly diphtheria epidemic that threatens the town and her own family.
Tragedy hovers over Dr. Mike’s family, and Daniel falls seriously ill, as the diphtheria epidemic continues to rage.
Dr. Mike must judge her neighbors when litigation fever strikes Colorado Springs.
Dr. Mike tries to mediate a treaty with the Indians despite the arrival of a famed Indian hater.

Alexis gets her revenge on Sable when she tells her tankers have sunk; Alexis is devastated when she discovers Dex slept with Sable; as Sammy Jo becomes increasingly fond of Tanner McBride, she is unaware that he is married.

Alexis is emotionally crushed by Dex's affair with Sable; Blake tells Dex and Sable beneath the lake is a Nazi treasure and his father killed Grimes to prevent him from exploiting it; Adam tries to win back Blake's trust so he can spy for Alexis.

Sable unleashes her lawsuit against Alexis; Dex dives into the hidden vault beneath the lake and finds it empty; Zorelli tracks down the uncle of Dominique Devereaux, learning he knows something about Grimes' murder; Alexis leaves for Switzerland.
Blake is a suspect in Elsworth Chisolm's apparent murder; Zorelli is put back on the Grimes case; Charles Matthews warns Blake that Zorelli has been asking him questions about Blake's father.

Jeff and Dex meet with Roger Grimes' wife and learn he has a son; Sable is pregnant and unable to tell Dex that he is the father; Adam has a picture of Jeff and Monica retouched to appear incestuous and then submits it to a sleazy tabloid.

Charles Matthews tells Blake a grim secret; Zorelli finds a bug hidden in his apartment; Alexis tells Monica that Jason Colby isn't her father; Alexis learns she has a Fredrick Stahl original and realizes Blake's deep, dark secret.

Alexis threatens to sue Blake for half of the plundered Nazi treasure unless Sable withdraws her lawsuits against Colbyco. Sable agrees; Krystina leads Fallon to the treasure. They are followed by Dennis Grimes.
As Krystle Grant Jennings prepares to marry wealthy oil tycoon Blake Carrington, Matthew Blaisdel, a former lover, returns to town and causes her second thoughts.

Blake's estranged son Steven returns home for the ceremony, as does rebellious daughter Fallon, who objects to the union. Blake and Krystle reconcile; Matthew is reunited with his wife and daughter; Walter's rig is sabotaged.
Blake and Krystle are married; Jeff Colby pursues a disinterested Fallon; Walter and Matthew form a business partnership; Claudia and Lindsay try without success to resolve their differences.
Urgent business cuts short Blake and Krystle's honeymoon; Steven takes a job working for Matthew Blaisdel; Cecil proposes that Fallon marry his nephew.

Blake invites Matthew to dinner at the mansion to entice him to return to Denver-Carrington; Krystle clashes with head butler, Joseph; Matthew tells Krystle he's still in love with her; Jeff attempts to win Fallon.
Steven's ex-lover, Ted, arrives from New York; Fallon reluctantly marries Jeff Colby; Blake hires Michael, the chauffeur, to do undercover work for Denver-Carrington.
Steven is taunted on the job for being gay; Blake learns of the terms of Fallon's marriage to Jeff; Steven finds himself attracted to Claudia.
Walter takes Steven to a bordello; Steven is blamed for sabotaging Matthew's rig; Krystle pawns her diamonds to help Matthew financially.

After being fired for sabotaging Matthew's equipment, an innocent Steven learns he was set up; Lindsay is shattered to learn about her birth; Blake tries to learn who bankrolled Matthew; Fallon warns Steven's ex-lover to stay away from her brother.
Matthew and Walter's well comes in; Fallon asks to borrow the necklace Krystle pawned to help Matthew; at his mountain cabin, Steven and Claudia make love.

Antonio, Jess and Colin forsake their vacation to help Nicole investigate the disappearance of her nephew.

The dancers prepare for the big opening night; Poppy's mother visits High Water; Zo gives Tal shocking news; Rigo receives unexpected help; Odalie takes a desperate last step.

The big tour begins; Dondre discovers a secret that can change everything between him and Poppy; Rigo discovers the truth about his father's death; Odalie has her moment of fame; Sage makes a dramatic proposal for Colette.

Accused of murdering his former friend East-O, Sage Odom is poised to lose everything in his empire; his partner and now fiancée Collette Jones is by his side supporting him, but Collette is hiding a deep secret.

A troubled Rigo must choose between abandoning the lucrative tour or headlining the tour to help rescue the man who possibly murdered his father; with his friend Poppy by his side, he turns the tables on Sage and Collette.

Grace's moving back to Memphis is motivated by vengeance for her sister's death; she struggles to work in the family's church.

Ip Man is the award-winning film adaptation about the life story of Ip Man, the grandmaster of the Wing Chun style of kung fu and sifu of legendary martial arts superstar, Bruce Lee.

Newly arrived in Hong Kong, martial arts instructor Ip Man encounters stiff opposition when he begins teaching the Wing Chun fighting style. But instead of bowing to his rivals' demands, he perseveres and retaliates with amazing speed and power.

In 1905, revolutionist Sun Yat-Sen visits Hong Kong to discuss plans with Tongmenghui members to overthrow the Qing dynasty. But when they find out that assassins have been sent to kill him, they assemble a group of protectors to prevent any attacks.

programmes.t: Legend of the Fist: The Return of Chen Zhen
programmes.d: Incredible martial arts sequences mark this thriller about a legendary fighter who takes on ruthless outside oppressors in World War II-era Shanghai.

Set in 198 A.D., when the Eastern Han Dynasty has collapsed into civil war, and the young Emperor is a puppet of prime minster and generalissimo Cao Cao (Jiang), the film singles out two famous chapters from Guan’s (Yen) many heroic adventures.
Liu Jin-xi (Donnie Yen) is a village craftsman whose quiet life is irrevocably shattered by the arrival of two notorious gangsters in the local general store.

An undercover cop (Donnie Yen) infiltrates one of China's most ruthless crime syndicates. He must risk everything to protect his family and his life after the boss (Collin Chou) vows to find and kill every traitor in his organization.
Four hundred years after being frozen in time, a Ming Dynasty palace guard and his three associates are thawed and left to adjust to the modern-day.

'Lights, Camera, Voodoo': Security guard Panther comes up against an egotistical star, a demented director and an obsessive fan at a movie studio. 'I'm Dreaming of a Pink Christmas': Pinky tries to instill the spirit of Christmas in a 'scrooge.'

'Wiener Takes All': The Panther runs a successful hot dog business until the competition kidnaps the founding granny. 'The Easter Panther': When the Panther is hired to handle the White House Easter Egg Hunt, he must foil a heist by the Dogfather.
Scott tries to earn money to pay for an electric guitar. He helps at his dad's shop, but finds raising money is a lot more difficult than he expected.
Scott and his family mysteriously become unable to control their wolf-outs and worry that the town monster, that has been covered in recent news reports, is actually them.

Mr. Bean gets a real bug for painting. Then several bugs… and flies and slugs and mice.

There’s easy money to be had in the art world and Mr. Bean is set on getting some of it.

Bean fights a losing battle with a winged beast from Hell.

When Mr. Bean finds a fly in his room, it's war. He needs weapons. Fly spray? A rolled-up magazine? These are only the start. In desperation, he enlists a mouldy doughnut, an encyclopedia.

The Battle of the Mimes. A leisurely stroll in the park turns into a run when Mr. Bean is chased home by an angry Mime Artist. He is lost for more words than usual when the street performer makes himself at home and insists on being wined and dined.

Mr. Bean finds that cleanliness can be a filthy business. It's the First Day of Spring and Mr. Bean sets about washing his clothes, his furniture, his teddy and himself.  But, alas, there’s no hot water!
Sabrina needs a little lesson in true love for her Shakespeare play. While Zelda just needs a date. They conjure up Romeo to teach them the ropes.
Sabrina is excited when her father drops in for a visit. She's disappointed to find that her father has brought along with him his fiancie.
It's Salem's birthday and he's used to getting the lavish gifts. Sabrina thinks her homemade gift sucks so she time travels to get him a unique gift...
Gem hosts two exchange students to be cool. Instead of the real foreigners, Dawson and Felicity, show up instead. Psst! They are really mischievous faeries.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Happy Families
programmes.d: A problematic family beach picnic leads Don to end his relationship with Samantha, until Cleo encourages him to pursue it. Will's sister, Sophie, competes with Bella for a job at the café and sets her sights on Zane.

Rikki and Bella hide out at Cleo's to protect themselves from a full moon water attack. However, Bella is kidnapped by a water tentacle and taken to Mako Island. Lewis tries to keep Will away from the island so the girls can rescue her.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: The Sorcerer's Apprentice
programmes.d: Cleo defies Lewis' advice and experiments with the magic Moon Pool water. Using her powers, Rikki accidentally gets the water into Cleo's aquarium and all the girls have to rescue Cleo's fish Hector.
Bella's warned to back off from Will as he's on the trail of the girls' mermaid secrets. She gets too close to him and he finally discovers she's a mermaid.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Just a Girl at Heart
programmes.d: Bella helps Will with his free-diving training but when she realises he's more interested in her as a mermaid than a girl, she's hurt. Rikki and Cleo have to improvise when the cafe's first corporate function is actually a children's party.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Crime and Punishment
programmes.d: Rikki receives counterfeit money at the café and is held captive by criminals on a boat. Bella and Cleo are forced to reveal the trio's secret to Will, so they can rescue Rikki together.

Unbeknownst to the boys, Cassy's been doing volunteer work before and after class, helping Dr. Mender, the resident bestial physician, tend to injured enchanted creatures. Cassy discovers she has a real gift for healing.
Class clown, Gus, is big on getting laughs. Cassy thinks she's just as funny and a competition begins.

Cassy is assigned to tend the school garden, where she discovers that the flowers are shrinking instead of growing. While trying to save a flower, she's yanked into “Rootopia,” – a bizarre underground realm.

After Samantha, Gus and Verne save a magical carpet from Zarlak, they've got to go back to their least favorite class at the Enchanted School -- Magical Histories, taught by their least favorite teacher -- the dull and boring Mr. Sternwand.

The girls discover a necklace for sale identical to Miss Chatham’s. Miriam causes a stir by buying it – then throwing it in the water. Rikki faces a choice whether to take the necklace and reveal her mermaidness to Zane.
Lewis thinks he’s found a way to control the girl’s mermaidness. The school dance brings all our heroines' 'boy issues' to the surface.
The return of Dr. Denman means trouble for the girls. Meanwhile, Emma is having family dramas of her own. With Zane’s unwitting help, Denman’s research at Mako Island uncovers the girls' secret!
Dr. Denman has discovered the girls' secret and trapped them on Mako Island. Their only chance to avoid being exposed is to use the lunar eclipse to give up their powers forever!
Under the influence of a Full Moon, the girls' powers are hugely enhanced and they wreak havoc on Lewis in his boat. The next day the girls realise they still need Lewis.
Emma uses her new powers to help Elliott win at soccer. Lewis decides to test the girls' increased powers. Cleo has had enough of Lewis' smothering and dumps him. Lewis meets Charlotte and they bond.
Simon and Marshall are cursed on Halloween by an odd occurrence involving Simon's little brother, the TV remote control, and a scary mummy movie.
Marshall uncovers a plot by a new school nurse, who's using an eye exam to hypnotize students to make them worker drones incapable of having fun.
Brothers Dwight and Stu are willing to do just about anything to come up with the money for a new P-11 Baja Sandslicer dirtbike, including stealing.
On a family picnic, brothers Rick and Teddy spend their time keeping three year-old sister Becky out of trouble, and waging war on a hill of ants with squirt guns and magnifying glasses.
Strict teacher Felix Purdy has always been tough on his students, particularly on introverted dreamer Daryl Kregman.

programmes.st: Gone Fishin' / A Little Body of Work
programmes.d: Young Randy is reluctant to accompany his Uncle Ned on a fishing trip / Delinquents Eddie and Herman have a bad habit of stealing parts for their hot rod from cars on the street.
When Sam's Uncle Paul, a caretaker at The Winchester Mystery House in San Diego, starts seeing ghosts, she must defend his sanity to save his job.
Rip, Sam, and Cyril travel to China, to photograph “Llama's Skull”, an artifact said to protect all those “in his vision”.
After Martin announces his support for a radical political candidate, Frasier and Niles decide to back the main opponent.
Frasier's budding relationship is put to the test when he bumps into his ex-wife, Lilith, while on vacation with his new love.
Jealousy rears its ugly head when Frasier bumps into Lilith and her new boyfriend while vacationing with his new girlfriend.
Martin finds it hard to "forgive and forget" when he runs into a former police buddy who's in the hospital.
Frasier and Niles confront the bullies who used to torment them in junior high school.
Roz and Frasier discover that breaking up is hard to do after Roz takes a new job as Bulldog's producer.
Frasier plays amateur sleuth after becoming caught up in Martin's obsession with a twenty-year-old unsolved murder.

programmes.st: Fool Me Once, Shame on You, Fool Me Twice...
