The cow that Oliver (Eddie Albert) bought from Mr. Haney is pregnant. Afraid that Haney will claim the new calf, Oliver and Eb decide to keep it secret...only to have the people of Hooterville think that it is Lisa (Eva Gabor) who is expecting!

It's the Douglases' wedding anniversary and, after initially pretending not to remember, Oliver (Eddie Albert) makes clear that he knows the date very well, he just can't remember exactly how many years he and Lisa (Eva Gabor) have been married.

Lisa (Eva Gabor) is shocked that Hooterville has no beauty parlor, and the Ladies' Every-Other-Wednesday Afternoon-Discussion-Club nominates her to make it happen. Of course, Oliver's mother is happy to help, even if it means underhanded tactics.

When Oliver's neighbor, Mr. Watson, decides to do some traveling, Oliver (Eddie Albert) buys the farm which adjoins his property, but not the house on it. Lisa (Eva Gabor) misunderstands and thinks the beautiful farmhouse is their new home.

Oliver (Eddie Albert) discovers the only requirement to join the Hooterville Valley Fire Department is that he must play a musical instrument. Meanwhile Lisa (Eva Gabor) tries her hand at cooking something besides "hotscakes" for breakfast.

Believing he will never get a moment's peace, Oliver (Eddie Albert) is annoyed when Lisa (Eva Gabor) puts a listing in the new phone book: "Oliver Douglas, Attorney at Law"�but it is a different story when no one calls for his services.

Oliver (Eddie Albert)'s apple crop is ready to be harvested, and he decides to take them to market himself and make a killing. Of course, getting to market before the price drops proves a little more difficult than Oliver anticipates.

Ralph (Mary Grace Canfield) becomes enamored of Mr. Kimball (Alvy Moore), the county agent. However, though she feminizes herself and gets all gussied up, he refuses to go out with a girl named Ralph. Can Oliver solve the situation legally?

Six months is up! Now, Lisa (Eva Gabor) gets to decide whether she and Oliver (Eddie Albert) will remain on the farm or go back to New York and their Park Avenue lifestyle! Will this be the final straw for Green Acres?

Sam Drucker (Frank Cady) is leaving on a much-needed two-week vacation and talks Oliver (Eddie Albert) into assuming his duties as deputy sheriff. But Oliver soon learns enforcing the law isn't quite as easy as it looks.

Whatever you do, don't say her name and especially while playing checkers down at Drucker's! An old hag named Molly Turgiss (Renie Riano), who died twenty years before the Douglases (Eddie Albert, Eva Gabor) came to town, might be haunting them.

It's a few days before Oliver (Eddie Albert)'s birthday, and Lisa (Eva Gabor) doesn't know quite what to get him�until the old Hoyt Clagwell goes kerflooey! So, she goes out and buys the biggest and fanciest tractor she can find.

Oliver (Eddie Albert) discovers that Eb (Tom Lester) has a way with sick animals after Eb cures Arnold, the pig, and Alice, the chicken, and offers to put him through veterinary college. But will life in Green Acres ever be the same without Ed?!

A horse follows Oliver (Eddie Albert) home, but every time he tries to show it to his wife, the horse disappears. Lisa (Eva Gabor) assumes that her husband is imagining things�and as more animals show up, Oliver begins to think so too.

Mr. Haney (Pat Buttram) takes Oliver (Eddie Albert) to Pixley Superior Municipal Court and sues him for non-payment of a vital contract over the little matter of some rain�or lack thereof. Does Mr. Haney know who he's up against? Does Oliver?

The Third-Tuesday-of-Every-Month-Culture-Committee of the Every-Other-Wednesday-Afternoon-Discussion-Club decides that Hooterville needs some "culture" in the form of a symphony orchestra. And Lisa (Eva Gabor) may just know the perfect conductor.

Oliver's (Eddie Albert) nephew Charles (Don Edmonds) arrives for a visit, and Oliver is completely shaken up when the boy turns out to be a long-haired, motorcycle-ridin', hippy-dippy type. But, boy, does he know a thing or two about engines.

Oliver dreams of entering his crop in the Corn Festival, but the dreaded "Bing Bug" invades Hooterville's farms. After learning of his service as a WWII pilot, the locals volunteer him for the perilous task of flying the town's only crop duster.

When a lovely, young and successful farmer comes to Oliver (Eddie Albert) for his legal counsel, Lisa (Eva Gabor) quickly becomes jealous of the two spending time together and becomes determined to break up what she sees as a budding romance.

When the Monroe Brothers show up to fix the Douglas's closet, Lisa learns that Ralph is devastated because her true love has stood her up on another date. Lisa's solution: an intensive, two-day beauty treatment for Ralph�and the barn for Oliver!

Oliver (Eddie Albert) takes to his soap box, delivering fiery, patriotic speeches after getting a bill from the State Farm Unattached Duty Tax for an outrageous $12.03! But no one can figure out why the tax is levied in the first place.

Lisa (Eva Gabor) is curious to learn about the book that Oliver (Eddie Albert) is reading. It is the "real-life" story of pioneers Gus and Etta Thompson. The episode flashes back to the 19th century with Oliver appearing as Gus and Lisa as Etta.

Eb (Tom Lester) seeks dating advice from the Douglas's after laying eyes on former classmate Betty Jo Bradley from "petticoat Junction." Oliver's well-intentioned guidance has mixed results when Eb hilariously misconstrues the advice he's given.

The locals complain that Oliver's penchant for wearing business suits to do farm work is ruining Hooterville's image. Oliver tries to adjust, but the last laugh is on him when Lisa has her dressmaker design Italian him some swanky new overalls.

The Hooterville Chamber of Commerce attempts to attract a Hollywood film studio to shoot a movie in town. And when a rumor spreads that famous actor is arriving, the townsfolk are all abuzz as they prepare for their close-up, Mr. DeMille!

Fed up with the house being in dire need of repair, Lisa demands that Oliver arrange to have the house redone or she's moving back to New York. Oliver agrees, but is delayed when Mr. Haney claims that their farmhouse is a historic monument.

Everything is topsy-turvy and henhouse hijinks ensue when one of the Douglas' hens is found to be laying square eggs! News of this kind gets around quickly, and the townsfolk all get in on the race to capitalize on the impressive novelty.

Oliver is absolutely determined to have a truly old-fashioned Christmas, including decorating his own farm-grown tree. But warm weather stands in the way and, he discovers, the residents of Hooterville aren't exactly as traditional as he thought.

In true Hooterville fashion, Oliver (Eddie Albert) discovers that the town is vehemently split as to which weather reporter they trust. As debates rage over which forecast is correct, Oliver plants his tomato crop, hoping for the best.

After another disastrous effort from Lisa in the kitchen, Oliver implores her to take a home economics class at the local high school. Before she knows it, Lisa is a fully enrolled student...the likes of which Hooterville High has never quite seen.

When the Hooterville City Council appoints Oliver (Eddie Albert) to judge the apple competition at the annual fair, he mistakes the honor for a real judgeship and prepares for his time on the bench! But a run-in with the real law clarifies matters.

Lisa visits Oliver's mother who is recovering from an illness. The doctor advises that she rest in a peaceful environment...and thinks that Hooterville sounds absolutely ideal! Of course, he doesn't know Hooterville, where peace is never�very close.

When Oliver (Eddie Albert) discovers that Hooterville has a still-valid contract to build war planes, he spearheads the opening of new government defense plant. But as chaos ensues, Oliver soon wonders if the move was a big mistake after all.

Lisa is appointed as head of Hooterville's new "Human Humane" committee. A perfect fit for animal-lover Lisa, and a relief from her boredom in the countryside, she soon has a menagerie of both farm and exotic animals living at Green Acres.

Oliver takes Lisa along to an agricultural convention. There, Lisa bonds with an ex-gangster couple, who insist upon teaching the Douglas's some of their shortcuts to successful farming. It turns out to be an offer that Oliver can not refuse.

Oliver champions agri-tech as way to increase productivity on the farm, but when a computer gives its assessment of the Douglas' marriage, Lisa (Eva Gabor) begins to question her union with Oliver. It's bits versus bytes in Green Acres!

Determined to teach his spendthrift wife Lisa how to save money, Oliver insists that she learn about farming...by growing her own vegetables! In her own inimitable fashion, armed with useless pamphlets from Mr. Kimball, Lisa sets to tilling!

When handyman Eb (Tom Lester) reports he has seen little green men piloting flying saucers, everyone in Hooterville takes him at his word�even the Air Force�and soon the Douglas farm becomes the Roswell of the greater Pixley area!

Ralph (Mary Grace Canfield) is distraught when her beloved Mr. Kimball, is fired as the county agricultural agent. Out of a job, Kimball (Alvy Moore) no longer has money enough to marry the lady-carpenter-in-waiting! But wait�did he even want to?

Lisa weaves the tale of her great, great grandmother, the Queen of the Gypsies, to explain a bizarre family tradition: a woman in her family must marry an American -- but only every fourth generation -- in order to gain a special inheritance.

After Oliver (Eddie Albert) accidentally drops a hammer on her head, Lisa (Eva Gabor) develops a case amnesia, with no idea who she is or why she is on a farm in Hooterville�and she adamantly refuses to believe that Oliver is her husband!

Nothing gets done on the Douglas farm when Oliver (Eddie Albert) gifts Eb (Tom Lester) a top-of-the-line radio for his birthday. Letting nothing stop him, Eb (Tom Lester) enters a radio contest...even when Eleanor the cow swallows the radio whole.

It's a very official third season premiere for Green Acres when the retirement of a state senator leaves Hooterville considering its best candidate for the job. Of course, they turn to their beloved lawyer-come-farmer Oliver Douglas (Eddie Albert).

Oliver finds himself in a jam after asking Lisa to make him homemade fruit preserves. An episode deliciously devoted to Lisa's culinary escapades, Lisa musters all of her Hungarian might to make Oliver the best peach jam he's ever tasted.

After years of substandard service, Oliver is hellbent on throwing the book at the Hooterville Phone Company. When it becomes clear that the local utility oversight board can't do much about it, he decides to handle matters directly.

Mr. Trendell, the president of the Hooterville Phone Company, hands the company over to a delighted Oliver. But after a day of crossed wires and a switchboard repairman with some lose connections of his own, Oliver is ready to call it quits.

For the first time, Oliver has a successful crop that needs picking. His tomatoes have grown beautifully. But matters at the phone company continue divide his precious time, so Oliver looks for an interested buyer to take the company off his hands.

Being president of the Hooterville Phone Company has been a rude awakening for Oliver. The switchboard operator is now calling him at five in the morning! After a bevy of new complaints from unhappy customers, Oliver has just about had enough.

One might think that when Eb takes a vacation things around the farm might go more smoothly. But when Eb elopes, leaving his cousin Walter to take his place, it turns out to be a horrible idea. Walter barely knows a weed from a hole in the ground!

Lisa is reminded that she stored a birthday present for Oliver years ago: a genuine Stavinsky. But what is it? It's a modern art sculpture that is two parts plumbing pipes, one part tire chains, and one part birdbath. Oliver calls it "The Thing."

The continually evolving story of how Lisa (Eva Gabor) and Oliver (Oliver) fell in love gets yet another version in this delightful episode. But one thing is for sure: Lisa and Oliver are just as in love today as the day when he fell out of the sky.

Green Acres is greener than ever, with jealousy. When Oliver (Eddie Albert) hires a handsome, young, intelligent Brit to take over his farm work while he is away, it doesn't take long for the newcomer to make a strong impression on Lisa (Eva Gabor).

Mr. Haney is up to his money-making schemes again. When a government representative tells Mr. Haney that the state is looking to purchase the Douglas farm for a new highway, Mr. Haney arranges to buy back the farm from the Douglases at a steal.

Ralph, the lady carpenter, runs away from home and stays with the Douglases after having a fight with her brother, Alf. While Oliver may never get his bedroom finished, he gains a maid as Ralph takes over as the Douglases' live-in housekeeper.

Picking apples while on a picnic, Oliver runs into the feisty Ira Hatch, the owner of the apple orchard. However, once back in town, Mr. Drucker tells Oliver that Hatch has been dead for years. An incredulous Oliver agrees to see a psychologist.

After his elopement and cross-country honeymoon, Eb returns to Hooterville. But his new wife is nowhere to be found! After sending postcards from all across the country, Eb has to confess that his fianc� stood him up at the alter on their big day.

Someone has stolen $300 from Mr. Drucker's general store, and it looks like Eb is the culprit. How else could he have bought himself a new car that cost, you guessed it, exactly $300? But that is just the first twist of the many turns of this story.

Lisa awakes, saying she's dreamt that she must invest in copper. When Oliver turns that idea down, she seizes on the opportunity to invest in a ten-year-old genius's electric company. Twenty-eight dollars buys her a third of the business.

Arnold, the Ziffels' television-loving pig, has taken on a paper route to save enough money for a new color set. But when bank robbers show up and threaten his dreams, and Lisa and Oliver are held captive in their own home, Arnold has to fight back.

The farmers of Hooterville are headed to France! Or at least they are if they can get organized. As part of an agricultural exchange program, the farmers are offered a chance to join a chartered government flight to Europe.

Lisa (Eva Gabor) is delighted to learn that her Hungarian mother is planning a visit to their little farm. Much to Oliver's (Eddie Albert) disbelief and dismay, a rumor spreads all around Hooterville that Lisa's mother is a European countess.

Love is in the air as the first day of spring arrives in Hooterville. And who better to lead the town in celebrating it than Lisa. She is resolved to show Oliver just what spring is all about and sets out to produce a Spring festival celebration.

It's a hair-raising episode as Eb (Tom Lester) enrolls in a correspondence course to become a barber. Lisa (Eva Gabor) and Oliver (Eddie Albert) give him the money to learn the trade but learning how to cut hair by mail has its glitches.

For a lawyer, Oliver should be more careful about what he signs. Lisa reminds him that two years ago Oliver made her a promise to take her back to New York for a two-week vacation. And she has it in writing� on the bottom of the kitchen drawer.

It's hard to know who has a curse over Oliver, but he sure has his hands full with Lisa and her fellow Hungarian Lazlo Broslav. Lazlo appears with a letter claiming he once saved the life of Lisa's uncle, and now her family must repay the debt.

There's a problem in Hooterville: no farmer seems able to grow a cash crop on account of the quality of the soil. But as it turns out from Oliver's (Eddie Albert) soil and mineral research, the oft misunderstood rutabaga is an ideal choice.

Green Acres goes Hollywood in this first installment of a two-part season finale. When Arnold the pig appears in a play at the Hooterville Theater, Lisa (Eva Gabor) arranges for an old friend to give Arnold a chance on the big screen.

It's a swine-sational third season finale for Green Acres, as Oliver and Lisa chaperone Arnold, the Ziffel's talented pig, to Hollywood for his big screen test. There's only one problem, Lisa failed to mention that Arnold is not your normal actor.

Hooterville is abuzz as the townsfolk enter a contest sponsored by Peterson's Poi Juice, with a trip to Hawaii as the top prize. But no one expects the winner to be Arnold, the Ziffels' talented pig. Maybe a pig might fly after all, to the islands!

A charity rummage sale asks for donated clothing. Being among the wealthier residents of Hooterville, the organizers look to the Douglases. It isn't long before Oliver has to stop Lisa from giving away his entire wardrobe!

Love is in the air when Eb is quickly engaged to Loreli Appleby, whom he has only known for a day. Eb tries to impress Loreli's father, a farmer, but in typical fashion, he accidentally ruins his future father-in-law's cabbage crop.

When Fire Chief Joe Carson is looking for a way to go to Miami, he hires Oliver as his assistant, hoping Oliver will pay for the trip. The plan backfires, no pun intended, when Oliver starts pointing out what a poor job the chief has been doing.

The highways in Hooterville are in dire need of repair. Oliver is fed up and believes he can make a difference by complaining to his state representative, Ben Hanks. But Hanks' popularity proves greater than his sense of responsibility.

Lisa feels like she should be contributing more and wants to start working in Oliver's construction business. Lisa is like a fish out of water as she arrives to the Monroes' workshop in overalls and causes one problem after another.

Lisa plays bovine matchmaker when Oliver and Lisa decide it is time for their female cow, Eleanor, to start providing milk for the farm. Oliver makes arrangements for Eleanor to mooooove in with the neighbor's bull, but Lisa has other ideas.

The townsfolk look forward to "Old Mail Day", when once a year undelivered mail is handed out. The delayed mail includes a letter all the way from 1917! Oliver is upset by the poor service, but his complaints land with more impact than he intended.

When word spreads that an agricultural student is coming to Hooterville to study with county agent Hank Kimball, no one seems to be interested. However, things change when the folks discover that the student is an attractive blonde.

This episode tells the unusual tale of Hooterville's founding. As the town prepares for its centennial, Oliver announces a reenactment of the town's origins and casts himself and Lisa in the roles of Horace and Doris Hooter.

When a blue feather arrives in the mail for Lisa, her Hungarian roots tell her that trouble is brewing. The feather is a symbol of malfortune to come, and she suspects it was sent by Hungarian gypsies, a warning that they are out to get her.

Don't count chickens before they hatch! Oliver thinks he's laid a gold egg of an idea when he decides to dive beak first into the business of raising chickens. Lisa, on the other hand, sees little difference between raising chickens and children.

programmes.t: A Minute to Pray, a Second to Die
programmes.d: In Tuscola, New Mexico, the Governor offers amnesty papers to all outlaws but gunfighter Clay McCord's appearance triggers a violent confrontation between the local marshal, McCord, and other outlaws.

Captain O’Hara saves Mary from Navajo warriors and brings her safely to Fort San Antonio. But her fiancé, Major Brooks, is not only O’Hara’s rival but also a ruthless enemy of the Native tribes. As tensions rise, O’Hara must fight for peace while facing personal betrayal and growing conflict.

programmes.t: I Am Sartana, Your Angel of Death
programmes.d: A bank that was thought to be impenetrable is robbed by a man wearing the trademark Sartana cloak. Our black-clad hero soon has a price on his head and must try to proof his innocence with the help of his shabby friend Buddy Ben.
A judge encounters a man (Frank Latimore) he once wronged after an Apache attack. The attack forces him, his fiancée and their fellow stagecoach passengers to take refuge at a rest stop.

Sabata and Mangosta are bank robbers, who after a bank job, through a series of events, end up teaming up with the bank clerk, Peter. They then go on the run with Peter's boss and a hired posse equipped with the latest technology in weapons on their trail.

programmes.t: Yellow Hair and the Fortress of Gold
programmes.d: Fiery blonde half-breed Yellow Hair and her easygoing sidekick the Pecos Kid are after a fortune in Mayan gold.

The Walker brothers took different paths—one an outlaw, one a Marshal, one a rancher. Yet they share one goal: avenging their father’s murder. When they finally find the killer, their clashing ideals lead to a deadly showdown.

In 1860s Mexico, General Ramirez hires American gunfighter Hallelujah to recover a stolen Aztec statue to win indigenous support. But a Scottish adventurer, feuding brothers, bandits, and the army are also in pursuit, turning the hunt into a chaotic race for power.

In San Felipe, bandits target gold meant for the railroad - until a decoy chest thwarts them. When newcomers arrive, a masked gunman begins sabotaging the outlaws. But the real mastermind may be the town’s respected leader, hiding treachery behind wealth and charm.

programmes.t: If You Want to Live... Shoot!
programmes.d: Johnny Dark returns from his gold mine and lands in a deadly crooked card game. Framed and hunted by bounty killer Stack, he’s wounded and taken in by the McGovern family - only to be caught in their land war against a ruthless railroad agent. As loyalties shift, Johnny’s past and fate collide.

programmes.t: Django Kill... If You Live, Shoot!
programmes.d: Various factions, feud over stolen gold in a surreal town.
A double-cross in an arms deal prompts Mexican revolutionary Pancho Villa to raid a US Army weapons depot in Columbus, New Mexico.

programmes.t: The Legend of the Lone Ranger
programmes.d: The sole surviving Texas Ranger (Klinton Spilsbury) of an ambush arranged by outlaw leader Major Bartholomew "Butch" Cavendish (Christopher Lloyd) returns to fight back as a great masked western hero, The Lone Ranger.

Sartana has a bounty on his head and he's wanted dead or alive. To eliminate this he makes a deal with the local politicians. If he hunts down the marauding Randal Brothers, the bounty will be removed.
Clayton's sister is raped and murdered. Time for lethal revenge!

In the late 1800's, an army captain tries to tame the open plains of Argentina which are dominated by Indians and bandits. To help do this, the captain brings in a party of women to keep his soldiers happy.

In early 20th-century Mexico, the guerrilla leader Tepepa is saved from execution by Doctor Price, an Englishman. Tepepa, a hero of the Revolution, is curious about the doctor’s motives. The chilling answer: to kill him himself. A deadly game of cat and mouse begins between Tepepa and the ruthless police chief, Cascorro.
A former gunman turned priest seeks vengeance on three bandits who are masquerading as law-abiding citizens.

Agent Joe Ford, nicknamed “Dynamite Joe” for his explosive methods, is assigned to escort a vital gold shipment after a string of deadly ambushes threatens U.S. finances. With danger at every turn, Joe’s skills and dynamite are the last hope to stop the outlaws behind the attacks.
Jeff sets out to murder each one of the five outlaws who robbed, raped and killed his poor sister.
Ramon's parents are killed by men of landowner John Barrett. While trying to get revenge, Ramon is wounded but has saved the life of Rezza, an old disillusioned killer.

Reverend Miller arrives in Tucson where he wants to build a church, but on the very day of his arrival a gang raids the bank and the people of Tucson, suspicious of the new reverend because he is carrying a gun, immediately blame him for the robbery.

programmes.t: Dig Your Grave Friend... Sabata's Coming
programmes.d: Steve McGowan returns from war to avenge his father’s murder by a ruthless landowner. Imprisoned, he escapes with a bandit and steals a stagecoach—only to find the villain’s fiancée inside. As hired guns close in, alliances shift, and the fight for justice takes an unexpected turn.
A young man goes back to his hometown ten years after killing the killer of his parents. Once there he is asked to help the sheriff.

A surprise bachelor and bachelorette party for Tee Tee and Shawn ends in disaster. Treach supports Egypt's music career while Sam faces serious prison time. Eric and Layzie visit Eazy-E's gravesite, but rumors around his death must be put to rest.

JoJo and Tanice find themselves in a marriage crisis when JoJo's stood up on a group date. Tee Tee and Shawn's wedding plans spiral out of control. Sam seeks guidance from Layzie. Danger strikes for Briana when police come knocking at her door.

Briana's arrest spirals into a traumatic breakdown. Egypt's family crisis leads her to reach out to Tee Tee. Twist is under Young Money pressure when he returns to the stage for a big performance. JoJo and Tanice's marriage struggle gets real.

Between Covid, financial issues, a rainstorm and Pep not being invited, Tee Tee and Shawn's wedding falls apart. JoJo and Tanice are rocked by challenges of married life. Eric confronts Layzie Bone about his involvement in the Eazy-E Documentary.

Tee Tee's wedding day spirals into chaos, but a surprise from Pep shocks all. Meanwhile, Treach warns Sam that a dangerous future lies ahead and enforces protection over Egypt. Jojo plans something special for Tanice to keep the marriage lit.

Tee Tee and Maureen confront Pep about Egypt. Briana's new fling shocks all and brings her face to face with Pep at a family party. JoJo fights to save his marriage with a big surprise for Tanice. Eric spills the tea on his past with Tee Tee.
Angela plans for baby number two and visits a fertility doctor. Tee Tee and Egypt's rivalry comes to an unexpected head. Egypt rushes to marry her fiancé Sam even though Sam faces serious jail time.

Egypt and Sam rush to the little white chapel, but when they drop the bomb on Pep and Treach, Pep objects! Tanice and Sakoya's feud comes to a head. Eazy-E's celebration pushes the group to come together in peace and settle their differences.

The 50th anniversary of Hip Hop brings Bone Thugs-n-Harmony, Treach, and Kurupt onto one stage. A new baby is coming, but not everyone thinks it's good news. Meanwhile, a long-held secret romance is exposed, and an old rival makes a dramatic return.

Cree confronts Briana over fiery sneak disses on social media; Sakoya suspects her Mom is not being honest and discovers a troubling secret. Tyran offers Sam support as he deals with the aftermath of meeting Treach. Twist finds himself a new crush.

A pregnant Egypt goes on tour with Pepa, while Sam stays home alone. Jojo returns to music, and asks Eric to collaborate on a song. Aaliyah and Eric clash over Eric's gambling habit. Tiny and Sakoya have an explosive argument over Tiny's love life.

TT and Shawn clash over their new life in LA, Vanessa gets liposuction, and Cree and Briana finally faceoff over Briana's fiery sneak disses. Meanwhile, Twist plays peacemaker, and Layzie surprises Sakoya by showing up to her skate party uninvited.

Sam switches careers from rapper to food truck owner. Cree and Briana have an explosive confrontation at Briana's party. JoJo makes an offer on a house in Los Angeles, but keeps it a secret from Tanice.

Tee Tee decides to bury the hatchet when she learns that Egypt is pregnant. Twist turns to God to resist temptation, and tries to find his way back to an old flame. Aaliyah has had enough with Eric's gambling, and decides to do something about it.

Jojo confronts Buck over his toxic behavior; Sakoya attempts to mend her relationship with Tiny. Egypt and Sam decide who will be invited to their wedding. Treach suspects Sam has ulterior motives for marrying Egypt. Layzie mourns his Mother.

Romeo says he's changed & wants to apologize, but will his apology be accepted? Sam's case goes to court, and he gets news he didn't want to hear. Eric and Aaliyah finally discuss their issues, and Tanice and her dad clash over throwing ice at Jojo.

Romeo wants to apologize to Angela and Jojo, but they're hesitant to meet with him. Egypt continues to plan her wedding amid Sam's court case and unanswered RSVPs. Angela performs for the first time, but will her nerves get the best of her?

Romeo & Angela talk for the first time in years, but can their relationship be healed? Sam & Egypt celebrate their second wedding ceremony. To celebrate 50 years of Hip Hop, legends grace the stage, along with the cast, in an epic performance.

Bow Wow's arrest blows up in the tabloids and causes an uproar with Da Brat. R. Kelly's arrest ignites a buzzing child support battle with ex-wife Drea Kelly. Waka Flocka and wife Tammy Rivera put their wedding renewal vows to the ultimate test.

Bow faces tough love about his arrest and a dark cloud threatens to send him back to jail. Tammy's heart-to-heart with Drea Kelly sparks a revelation about her marriage to Waka. Deb's godson Brandon returns but bad blood isn't reconciled so easily.

A surprise visit from Angela Simmons rocks Bow's world! Tammy's insecurities threaten her first sexy music video. Ayana and Brandon face off and Waka questions Brandon's motives. Eazy-E's daughter seeks guidance from Deb and Brat.

Breaking news regarding R. Kelly's child support battle explodes into chaos. Deb and Brat clash over Drea Kelly. Ayana raises suspicions about Brandon firefighting; Bow and Brandon face off. ReeMarkable's performance backfires.

JD's throws a star-studded skate party including Usher and T-Boz. Snoop dishes out tough love on Bow. Brat blows up on LisaRaye when bankruptcy pushes her to a breaking point. Waka warns Deb that Brandon needs to steer clear of the family or else.

Bow enters dangerous territory when he meets a fiery new woman. ReeMarkable blows off her boyfriend and suffers the pay back. Deb has a family dinner to confront Brandon about a big fat lie. Waka reaches his boiling point and goes in for the kill.

Brandon's lies are exposed and that brings Brandon and Waka nearly to blows. Warning signs arise when Corri marks her territory with Bow. Brat questions ReeMarkable's intentions. Bow disses Drea Kelly right to her face.
Tammy goes ballistic when she catches Waka in a lie. Bow is blindsided when he learns of Corri's dangerous past. ReeMarkable disrespects Deb and Da Brat and battle lines are drawn.

After putting Corri on ice, Bow makes a bold move and invites his ex, Angela Simmons to Shaniah's 21st birthday bash. Corri keeps tabs on Bow's moves. Tension between Da Brat and Drea Kelly escalates. Waka enters the lion's den with Tammy.

Brandon returns and makes a shocking confession. Deb and Brat explode after giving ReeMarkable one last chance. All hell breaks loose when Corri shows up on a rampage against Bow. Tammy's big NYC show goes off the rails.

As Atlanta emerges from quarantine, the cast struggles to navigate a new world in troubling times. Bow's scandalous album rocks Atlanta, Ayana receives a terrifying health diagnosis, and Deb drops a bomb that shocks Waka and threatens her reputation.

Despite warnings, Bow threatens to tell all about his exes on his new album. When an ex shows up in ATL, Bow is forced to face the past. Deb's secret creates turmoil that could tank her reputation. The stress of it sends someone over the edge.

Tammy and Deb clash over politics; Waka gets caught in the crossfire. Pimpin' has to face the music when his ex Diamond confronts him. Sexual tension fuels their fiery fight suggesting they may not be over after all. Jhonni has to fess up to Deb.

Brat presses Judy to move to ATL. Hurricane's desperate to help a sick Ayana, but Shaniah takes a different approach. Ree's ready to reconcile with Brat and Deb, but will they give her another chance? Diamond's album release party ends in turmoil.

A fight at Diamond's party steals her spotlight, creating a conflict that threatens to tear the cast apart when Deb unites everyone on a new project. Brat is angry when she hears that Deb is keeping things from her. Ayana recovers from COVID-19.

Bow and Brat refuse to be part of Deb's project, causing a huge rift that may be permanent. Turning to Waka for help, Deb might not like the tough love he gives. Ree wants to make things right with Ayana over an ugly Twitter feud, but Ayana refuses.

Brat appeals to JD about Bow's scandalous new album, but his response throws her for a loop. Shaniah and JD join forces to make positive changes in their community. BT's birthday party culminates in an all-out girl fight.

Jesseca persuades Brat to give Jhonni another chance, but tempers flare when Brat and Jhonni face off. Bow learns that one wild night could affect the rest of his life. Tammy's shocked when Ayana and Ree's longstanding feud spirals out of control.

Pimpin' and Diamond call it quits, and Khi can't resist making a move when he learns Diamond is single. Meanwhile, Bow anxiously awaits the results of his paternity test and considers how a baby son could impact his future.

Bow finds out if he's a new daddy. An emergency at Deb and Brat's EP party causes Jhonni to suffer a cataclysmic meltdown, and Waka is caught in the crossfire. Meanwhile, Diamond embraces newly single life, and Khi prepares to make his move.

Angela opens up about her devastating breakup and the pressures of living in the spotlight. Vanessa throws a party to reunite the heirs and clear the air while Romeo gets caught up in a love triangle. Boogie's addiction takes a turn for the worst.

Tee Tee and Briana beef over Romeo's affections. Dame enlists Master P to scare Boogie straight. Angela moves to LA for a fresh start. Romeo hopes to get close to his newly-single former flame. Red flags are raised about naive Egypt's relationship.

Game night at Pepa's house spirals into fight night! Dame and Pep clash over the severity of Boogie's addiction while Briana enters to confront a nasty rumor. Angela and Romeo reunite for the first time since Angela's breakup.

Angela and Romeo's Orlando getaway leads to a hotel nightcap. Briana and Pepa clash at a releasing ceremony when Pepa brings alcoholic spirits. Boogie is blindsided when he is lead to a surprise drug intervention.

Boogie's intervention spirals out of control when Kristinia and Briana nearly come to blows! Romeo and Angela discuss their relationship. Angela drops a bomb on her and Vanessa's business plan. On the brink of destruction, Boogie checks into rehab.

Pepa's son Tyran comes to town with old baggage in tow. Tyran interrogates Egypt's boyfriend Sam. Drama ensues at a welcome party for Tyran. Master P is blindsided when he discovers that his incarcerated brother has gone on a hunger strike!

The danger surrounding Master P's incarcerated brother comes to a head. Tee Tee plays cupid for Briana to make amends, but her grand plan backfires! Tyran struggles to get Pepa's attention. After a blowup, Angela and Vanessa must unite for charity.

Boogie is released from rehab and temptation strikes! Master P mentors the guys on a camping trip. Family therapy with Pepa and her son, Tyran, bursts into flames. Kristinia meets her cousin Kyndall, El DeBarge's daughter, for the first time ever.

Angela and her siblings talk about marriage while Tee Tee goes on a first date with Romeo. Tee Tee's hair event sparks trouble when Kristinia's cousin, Kyndall, and her enemy, Briana, face off. Since their fight night blowup, Pepa and Dame reunite!

Tamara, guía de una galería de arte privada, es acusada de robar las joyas del renombrado coleccionista Dubrovsky. Indignado, él la busca para encararla, pero descubre que ella también es víctima de la estafa, no la villana que imaginaba. Entre ambos nace un romance. Pero el amor no será sencillo: Tamara lleva años enamorada en secreto del dueño de la galería, de cuyo favor depende su suerte, y Dubrovsky está casado con una esposa que no piensa quedarse de brazos cruzados.

¿Cuál es la mejor opción? ¿Un refugio familiar tranquilo o un romance apasionado? ¿Una esposa, con la que ha vivido durante décadas, o una joven amante? Después de pensarlo mucho, el protagonista de la película, Alexei, de 40 años, opta por rehacer su vida...
Alexei confiesa su infidelidad y deja a Vera. Se casa con Marina, pero pronto conoce a otra mujer, Varvara, con quien siente una conexión profunda.
Alexei busca a Varvara y se enamora de ella. Marina descubre su romance y le envía fotos comprometedoras, desatando una crisis.
Marina exige el divorcio. Alexei encuentra en casa de Varvara objetos de su antiguo hogar con Vera y descubre una impactante verdad.

Al financiar sola su temporada de minería y decidida a comenzar su búsqueda de jade un mes antes, Claudia se ve obligada a repensar su estrategia.
Robin sigue una corazonada sobre un nuevo sitio en un antiguo reclamo.
Guy lucha con la excavadora para exponer un hallazgo enorme.
La tripulación se enfrenta a una peligrosa recuperación en las orillas del río Turnagain.
Recortar un posible hallazgo de un millón de dólares queda en suspenso cuando falla un equipo antiguo.
El corte finalmente comienza en la lente de jade gigante en Dynasty, pero grandes fracturas cortan la lente.
Los aguaceros amenazan la seguridad de la tripulación y cierran la minería en el Pozo 3.
Cuando un importante comprador de jade no queda impresionado con la lente Pozo 3, Claudia se ve obligada a tomar una decisión difícil.
La carrera para preparar el campamento en Wolverine se convierte en una pesadilla.
El brutal viaje a una nueva mina separa a la familia y lleva a Josh al límite.
Claudia está ansiosa por comenzar a construir el nuevo sitio.
Los pequeños lujos en el campamento animan a un equipo descontento y los visitantes sorpresa aumentan las esperanzas de Claudia.
Gary y Josh no regresan de una búsqueda rutinaria de combustible y los núcleos de perforación ponen en duda la calidad de las lentes de jade en 2 Mile.
La tripulación finalmente logra un gran éxito, pero con el invierno acercándose, a Claudia le preocupa que el gran hallazgo haya llegado demasiado tarde.
Claudia está desesperada por comenzar a minar, pero las brutales condiciones del camino la hacen preguntarse si la tripulación logrará llegar a su reclamo.
Mientras Guy y Gary se apresuran a arreglar el camino destrozado hacia el reclamo, Claudia espera que un nuevo miembro de la tripulación sea el billete de la suerte.
La juerga de compras sorpresa de Robin estresa a Claudia cuando sus errores de compra retrasan la temporada minera.
Claudia intenta mantener la paz cuando Robin y su padre chocan, mientras el equipo lucha por solucionar un problema tras otro en su camión minero.
Gary y Josh están frustrados por una serie de crisis, mientras Claudia hace un anuncio impactante que descarrila los planes de Robin y provoca un conflicto entre la pareja.
Tensions boil over between Robin, Josh and Steve about how to mine and when Claudia steps in, things get downright explosive.
Plagados de problemas con los camiones, Robin y su equipo corren para hacer un suministro de combustible antes de que el equipo se agote.
Robin choca con Claudia y Josh por la calidad del jade que sale de su pozo, mientras que el intento de Larry de ayudar a llevar el barracón de la tripulación al campamento fracasa.
Claudia y su equipo están decididos a seguir minando a pesar de los incendios forestales que arden alrededor de su reclamo, hasta que las cosas empeoran y tienen que correr para salir.
Después de perder dos semanas de minería en los incendios forestales, Claudia y Robin corren el riesgo de regresar a Two Mile y apostar por la apertura de un nuevo pozo.
Claudia se estresa tratando de preparar su mejor jade para los compradores, mientras la moral de su equipo se pone a prueba mientras luchan contra el frío.
Claudia hace todo lo posible para intentar hacer una gran venta a los compradores de jade, mientras en la mina Guy y Gary luchan contra la primera tormenta de nieve de la temporada.
Claudia presiona a su equipo para que siga minando a pesar de las gélidas temperaturas y el deterioro de las condiciones de las carreteras.
La temporada de Claudia comienza con fuerza cuando recibe un pedido de jade por valor de 250 000 dólares.
Después de años de obtener la parte dura del trato con Scrappy Larry, Robin le hace una broma a su viejo amigo.
Bajo presión para cumplir con el ajustado plazo de su comprador, Robin y Josh chocan cuando se topan con interminables problemas.
Cuando una avería grave amenaza con cerrar la mina, Claudia y Robin toman la arriesgada decisión.
Josh evita por poco el desastre al entrar a la mina con una carga de combustible y Claudia queda devastada.
Claudia y Robin se apresuran a encontrar una segunda roca de jade antes de que su comprador abandone el trato.
Claudia recurre a su padre Steve en busca de ayuda cuando teme que la mayor venta de su carrera minera se le esté escapando de las manos.
La tensión surge entre Claudia, Robin y Josh mientras hacen un último intento por cerrar un trato con un comprador de Vietnam.
Mover una enorme losa de jade pone a prueba el antiguo equipo de la mina y la paciencia de Josh.
Arrastrar una roca de 20 toneladas por el peligroso camino para salir de la mina resulta demasiado para su viejo camión 6-Pack.
Robin descubre una enorme lente de jade en Two Mile, pero podría ser demasiado grande para que su pequeña operación la excave.
Cuando una extraña tormenta de nieve en agosto deja a Claudia y Robin varados en Two Mile, Gary y Garon intentan salvar el día conduciendo a través de la tormenta.
Robin toma una decisión difícil sobre su querido camión minero 6-Pack después de otra costosa avería.
Con el invierno acercándose, Claudia lleva a su exhausto equipo al límite, provocando que los ánimos se caldeen.
La nueva temporada minera está llena de sorpresas desagradables, pero un rescate improbable salva el día.
Harto de trabajar para su padre, Josh inicia su propio negocio de transporte por carretera con un semirremolque nuevo.
El camión del ejército muere en el brutal camino hacia la mina.

Immerse yourself in darkness with this collection of raw, atmospheric black metal. From blistering tremolo riffs to unholy vocals, this playlist evokes ancient rituals and nocturnal desolation. Enter the abyss and join the ceremony.

Ditch the pre-workout and let the riffs do the heavy lifting. This high-octane blast of speed and power is designed to fuel your gains or ignite a living room mosh pit. High BPMs, crushing drums, and zero excuses.

Embark on a heroic quest fueled by soaring vocals, blistering guitar solos, and triumphant symphonic melodies. This playlist delivers high-energy anthems, epic fantasy tales, and pure, unstoppable speed metal glory.
Look no further! This is the right place for everything heavy. Your quest has ended so, lean back, turn up that sound system to a solid 11 and enjoy the ride. You have been warned…

Brace for pure sonic devastation! Featuring relentless blast beats, guttural vocals, and razor-sharp riffs, this collection captures the raw intensity and uncompromising brutality of death metal at its absolute peak. Prepare for impact!

As you found your way to our sophisticated TV channel, these music videos should hopefully satisfy your need for cool new Metal- & Rock content. Enjoy and let your friends know! Remember, we’re in this together.

Grand orchestral arrangements meet crushing heavy metal in a majestic display of power. Featuring operatic vocals, sweeping strings, and cinematic soundscapes, this collection delivers pure, dramatic drama on an epic scale.
In this madcap farce, two Chicago musicians disguise themselves as women to avoid the mob.
Jack Lemmon and Shirley MacLaine are delightful in this tale of love and ambition.
Billy Wilder's bawdy, charming and romantic farce about a French policeman who falls in love with a prostitute
A TV cameraman is accidentally clobbered during a football game and is convinced to feign a serious injury.
A lone juror must convince eleven others that a teen accused of murder is innocent.
Lindsay Crouse and Joe Mantegna star as an unlikely team of con artists is David Mamet's directorial debut.
A former thief and a brash young drifter team up to pull off the perfect heist in this bold crime thriller!
A master safe cracker plans one last heist for the sake of a woman...and a whole new life.

programmes.t: To Live And Die In L.A.
programmes.d: Federal agent Richard Chance vows to take down a murderous counterfeiter by any means necessary.
Action-packed spy thriller about mercenaries out to steal a top-secret briefcase for a mysterious client.
Philip Marlowe faces the most bizarre case of his life, when a friend's suicide turns into a double murder.
Steve McQueen stars as a sophisticated tycoon who pulls off a stunning bank heist. Co-starring Faye Dunaway.
Meryl Streep stars in one of the most visually and emotionally stunning love stories ever to grace the screen.
A fugitive (Richard Gere) heads to L.A. to track down Monica, a beautiful French woman studying at UCLA.
Three young women sling pizza and dream of a future far away from Mystic, their small town.
A whimsical misfit (Johnny Depp) moves into Benny and Joon's lives and charms his way into Joon's heart.
A playboy (Richard Gere) has never thought about commitment until he meets Charlotte (Winona Ryder).
Cher, Winona Ryder, and Christina Ricci shine as an unpredictable mother and her two quirky daughters.
A superstitious widow is ready to remarry...until she falls in love with her fiancé's brother!

Gene Hackman and Tommy Lee Jones headline this explosive action-thriller about Green Beret (Hackman) who uncovers a terrifying military conspiracy when he is tasked with escorting a U.S. soldier (Jones) back to the States for a court martial.

In this provocative thriller, an American (Richard Gere) on a business trip in China is framed for a brutal murder and soon finds himself at the mercy of a foreign court system he doesn't understand. Can he find the true killer before it's too late?

Kevin Costner and Gene Hackman star in this taut, political thriller that sees Costner, as Naval Commander Tom Farrell, on the hunt for a very real killer and a very unreal Russian mole, and all the clues lead back to himself. Sean Young co-stars.

The evil Skeletor (Frank Langella) is poised to conquer the universe. But fear not! He-Man (Dolph Lundgren) has declared war on Skeletor, and the battle between good and evil has come to Earth. Courtney Cox also stars in the epic, action-adventure.

In this nail-biting action film, when an aging hitman (Charles Bronson) takes on an eager apprentice (Jan-Michael Vincent) they become an unmatchable team of killers...until the pupil's ruthlessness puts the two on a deadly collision course!

Cinema tough guy Charles Bronson stars as Majestyk, an ex-con and Vietnam vet, whose efforts to run a farm are thwarted by narrow-minded locals and corrupt cops. But when a Mafia hitman destroys his crop, the farmer's fuse is finally blown.

Hard-hitting action, cross-country adventure and a government conspiracy that goes all the way to the top highlight this pulse-pounding political thriller in which Charles Bronson must protect the First Lady (Jill Ireland) from ruthless assassins.

Paul Kersey (Charles Bronson) is no victim: He fights back – with a vengeance! After beginning a new life in L.A., Kersey's daughter is viciously assaulted. Now, he won't rest until he tracks the assailants down...and puts them all in the ground!

A battle-weary Paul Kersey (Charles Bronson) longs to leave his fighting days behind him. But when he arrives in New York to visit a friend and finds him brutally attacked, the silent avenger must wage war again in this no-holds-barred thriller!

Paul Kersey (Charles Bronson) is on a mission to take down the L.A. drug trade after his girlfriend's teenage daughter tragically dies of an overdose. He's armed and dangerous...and mad as hell in this take-no-prisoners, pulse-pounding thriller.

programmes.t: Death Wish V: The Face Of Death
programmes.d: Former vigilante Paul Kersey (Charles Bronson) has moved back to New York and is leading a quiet life. But when his beautiful fiancee (Lesley-Anne Down) is killed, once again upholding the law becomes his way of life...and this time it's for good!

Charles Bronson is Leo Kessler, a cynical cop on the trail of Warren Stacy (Gene Davis), a homicidal maniac. When the legal system sets Stacy free, Kessler has one option: to hunt down Stacy on his own before the crazed killer can strike again!
A vicious gang forces Akira to shed his quiet persona and reveal his other identity...that of a skilled Ninja!

When his partner is killed during a drug bust, a federal agent throws away his badge and the rule book with it. Arming himself with an array of deadly weaponry including nunchucks and ninja stars, he sets out to settle the score with the bad guys.
A one-woman vigilante force is out for revenge against those who hooked her sister on drugs.
Foxy Brown (Pam Grier) vows vengeance against those responsible for the death of an undercover officer.
Action legends return to the genre that made them famous in this big, brassy and action-packed tale!

Boot up for suspense and high-powered excitement with Jonny Lee Miller and Angelina Jolie when a group of hackers, the rebels of the information age, find themselves embroiled in a plot that could destroy the world's ecosystems…or their own lives.

In this sizzling, fast-paced thriller, computer whiz Milo Hoffman (Ryan Phillippe) lands his dream job at a major computer company, only to learn that the C.E.O. (Tim Robbins) may employ some very unorthodox -- and very deadly --business practices.

When a rookie cop goes undercover at a Porsche garage doubling as a chop shop, the fast cars and wild parties have him thinking that his suspect has the life he wants. But there may be more going on than just car theft...and he may be in too deep!

Charlie Sheen, Michael Biehn and Bill Paxton are three of America's finest Navy commandos. Sent to rescue the crew of a U.S. aircraft carrying Stinger missiles seized by Mideast terrorists, they're thrust onto the frontline of an explosive conflict!
Scott Bakula stars as a detective who gets more than he bargains for in this thriller that rips apart the boundaries between the illusion and magic.

Humans are such easy prey! H.P. Lovecraft's classic tale of suspense becomes "a grisly amalgam of sex, shock and satire" (Newsweek) in the hands of the creators of "Re-Animator." Jeffrey Combs and Barbara Crampton star in this cult-classic!

The Vicious Lips get a shot to make it as the galaxy's next big musical act, but their hopes soon come crashing back to earth. Hastily signing up the wide-eyed Judy Jetson to front the band, the Lips blast off on their meteoric rise to superstardom.
A Canadian Mountie and his trusty steed search a summer cheerleading camp to find a deranged lunatic...in a camp full of deranged lunatics!
Two young lovers are stranded overnight in a van, unaware they’re outside the mansion of a revenous vampire who is feeding on any trespassers!
It's a love story with bite when a revived Count Yorga roams the city in search of new blood…until he finds a girl to share eternity with!

Scientist Patrick Corey has a hideous hobby - he keeps brains alive! But when the brain of dead murderer W.H. Donovan falls into his possession, he finds that it has a mind of its own�and is controlling him through telepathic messages!

To restore the life of his fiancee, who was decapitated in an automobile accident, a brilliant surgeon tries to find a suitable body to attach to her head, which he keeps alive and locked in a dungeon. But nothing will stop her from getting revenge!

In this cult-classic zom-com, two totally awesome Valley Girls (Catherine Mary Stewart, Kelli Maroney) kick some zombie butt and go on the lam from bloodthirsty scientists after a passing comet turns all of Los Angeles into the walking undead!

A 300-year old vampire (rock star Adam Ant) tries to "re-humanize" after falling in love with a beautiful "mortal."  His attempts are thwarted, however, by his jealous vampire lover and his new love's jealous fiancee.  Can an ancient vampire find love and happiness in the 20th century?
Every 22 years, a jinxed vampire is fated to lose his beloved at the hands of a crazy pirate. But with his new band, he’s going to end the curse!
Mark wants to go all the way. His girlfriend won’t, but he meets a beautiful vampire who will! The problem? He’s starting to feel a little batty.
After being bitten on the neck during a night of passion, an agent is convinced he's a vampire.

In this horror cult-classic, Vincent and his sister own the "Motel Hello," where they sell their delicious smoked meats made fresh on their farm. But something strange is going on over there. Folks are checking in...but no one is checking out!

Gather around the campfire....to die! After a cruel joke severely disfigures him, camp caretaker Cropsy is back -- with hedge clippers in hand -- seeking revenge on those who scarred him! Can the campers save themselves before he kills them all?

Lefty Enright (Dennis Hopper) seeks to avenge the murder of his kin by Leatherface, Chop-Top, The Cook and Grandpa. With the help of a radio DJ he finds his way to their underground slaughter shop, where a battle of epic proportions will soon rage.

Five years after the massacre at Camp Arawak, Angela is now working at Camp Rolling Hills. She's still crazy...for camping and good clean fun, that is. But Angela draws the line at bad behavior and she's going to teach some naughty campers a lesson!

Under inept new management, Camp Rolling Hills is now Camp New Horizons and it's the ideal setting for a notorious psychopath like Angela Baker to do what she does best, eliminating "immoral" teenagers with everything from a knife to a lawnmower.
The streets of London are transformed into a smorgasbord for an alien creature with a taste for human flesh. Don't just panic…run for your lives!

John Saxon, Dennis Hopper and the legendary Basil Rathbone star in this atmospheric -- and influential -- sci-fi cult classic as a team of astronauts embark upon a rescue mission to Mars only to encounter a seductive alien, The Queen of Blood!
Colonel West returns from an historic trip to Saturn with a strange ailment: his flesh is melting! And only human flesh and blood will keep him alive!

Discover the true meaning of survival of the fittest as a terrifying creature from the past brings the future to its knees in this Danish-American kaiju creature feature about a cold-blooded 90-foot killer whose time has come... again!

In South Korea's first entry into the kaiju genre, a monstrous creature creates destruction throughout Korea as scientists race against time to create a refrigerant that may be the only weapon to stop the monster before it destroys the country!
It's angry, hungry, well-armed and ready to sample the local cuisine! John Huston, Shelley Winters and Henry Fonda star in this gripping thriller!

Stacy Keach, Haris Yulin and Faye Dunaway give riveting performances in this controversial and myth-shattering reexamination of the darker side of gunslinger Doc Holliday and the actions that led to the infamous showdown in Tombstone, Arizona.

Director John Sturges presents a reworking of the Wyatt Earp/Doc Holliday legend and the struggle for political control of Tombstone, with a marvelous trio of antagonists: James Garner as Earp, Jason Robards as Holliday, and Robert Ryan as Clanton.

Get ready for fast-paced, explosive action as Lee Van Cleef stars as Sabata, the mysterious, steely-eyed gunslinger who, after he discovers the masterminds behind an elaborate bank heist, imposes his bullet-laced brand of justice on a guilty town.

Under the brutal rule of garrison leader Col. Skimmel, a group of Mexican revolutionaries hire gunslinger Sabata (Yul Brynner) to rob a transport of gold in order to buy weapons. But the Colonel has other plans...taking the gold for himself.

The great Lee Van Cleef ("Death Rides a Horse") returns as the famous freewheeling gunslinger Sabata. In this third and final go-round for the enigmatic sharpshooter, Sabata seeks revenge when a band of desperadoes bilks him out of $5,000.

When a small town on the Paria River is decimated by a group of vile outlaws, the bandits get more than they bargained for after the local bargeman turns the tables on the vicious gang! Lee van Cleef and Warren Oates star in this rousing western.

Charles Bronson and Will Sampson star as Wild Bill Hickok and Chief Crazy Horse in this one-of-a-kind western that finds both western legends braving the snowy wilderness in search of the demon that haunts them both, the fabled White Buffalo!

Charles Bronson gives a standout performance as an Apache on the run from a blood-thirsty posse led by an ex-Confederate officer (Jack Palance). Eventually, the pursued and the pursuers will become reversed deep into the Apache desert.

Charles Bronson plays Graham Dorsey, a bank robber who, through a series of twists and turns finds himself the object of national adoration. A beautiful widow, Amanda Starbuck (Jill Ireland) is responsible for creating this myth.

As a train races through the Rocky Mountains, the passengers are being murdered! The only hope is John Deakin (Charles Bronson) who uncovers a secret that explodes in a torrent of shocking revelations, explosive brawls, and blazing gun battles.

Lee Van Cleef and  John Phillip Law star in this bona fide Spaghetti Western classic as, fifteen years after bandits massacred his family, a young man seeking revenge forms an unlikely alliance with the outlaw who was framed for the murders.

Mercenary Sergei Kowalski (Franco Nero) joins up with a Mexican revolutionary Paco Roman (Tony Musante) to rob a silver mine and bring new order to Mexico by force! Jack Palance and Giovanna Ralli co-star in this brilliant spaghetti western.

The results are explosive when an Irish terrorist (James Coburn) with a dynamite obsession teams up with a Mexican peasant-turned- revolutionary (Rod Steiger) in this action-packed tale of power and politics. Directed by the legendary Sergio Leone.

A man recently released from a five-year prison sentence seeks vengeance against the former friend who has violated his trust and sought his death. Starring Thomas Hunter, Henry Silva, and Dan Duryea.

programmes.t: A Reason To Live, A Reason To Die
programmes.d: From director Tonino Valerii comes this top-notch spaghetti western set during the Civil War where eight condemned Union prisoners attempt to capture a Missouri fort from Confederate soldiers. James Coburn, Telly Savalas and Bud Spencer star.

East Meets West in this charming spaghetti western in which three petty crooks try to transform an East Coast dandy into a real Wild West man! Starring Terrence Hill, Gregory Walcott, Harry Carey Jr. and Dominic Barto and directed by Enzo Barboni!

James Garner stars in this rollicking western spoof that has him taking on the job of a frontier town sheriff who must fend off villains (led by Walter Brennen) from every direction...all without breaking a sweat or dirtying his shiny black boots!

James Garner is back in the saddle again as hustler Latigo Smith whose latest con is passing off cowhand Jug (Jack Elam) as the dreaded gunman Swifty Morgan. But when the real Swifty shows up, the Wild West is going to get a whole lot wackier!

Frontier scout Jess Remsberg leads a wagon train through hostile territory to Fort Conchos. But underneath his valor, he has an ulterior motive: to settle a score with the man he believes killed his wife. James Garner and Sidney Poitier star.

Archie (Gregory Peck) and his partner, Billy (Desi Arnaz, Jr.) are bandits by trade, staging daring robberies throughout the American frontier. But when their latest heist takes a deadly turn, they are pursued by a ruthless marshal (Jack Warden).

Your Day 1 practice offers an invitation to slow down and take stock.

Your Day 2 session invites you to use the tools of the at-home yoga practice to befriend your body and your breath. Build on the art of noticing from Day 1 as we expand our vocabulary with a focus on a strong foundation. This session encourages a healthy flow of energy up and down the spine and lovingly guides you to learn how to take responsibility for your experience on the mat.

Your day 3 practice invites you to get to know your body through the structure of the practice and the art of aligning. We build on day 1 and 2 with a focus on action and alignment through asana and energy.

Your Day 4 practice provides you the opportunity to lean in when you feel discomfort to embrace the process of finding ease. Discover layers of your home practice as we look at our patterns and continue to build a dynamic vocabulary that serves.

Qigong is considered one of the five branches of Chinese Medicine, a foundational basis for martial arts, and a long-standing spiritual practice revered in Daoist and Zen traditions. In this video, your qigong teacher, Mimi Kuo-Deemer, introduces you to the etymology of qigong and the history of the 8 Silk Brocades you will practice in this course.
Let any burdens you carry drop away while you move through this gentle, intentional qigong practice.

This practice begins by tending to both the Yin and Yang meridians in your body. You’ll start with a soothing self-massage, which is beneficial to the health of your vagus nerve, especially if you experience overwhelm or often feel depleted. Allow yourself to feel calm and bright as you practice the fifth and sixth Silk Brocades.

As humans, we need interconnection: We rely on others to survive, especially as children. Yet, we also strive for authenticity. This creates an inherent tension. In this lesson, Dr. Maté discusses what is true human nature — and how the modern world has warped our understanding of our needs.

Trauma is a wound that you sustain; it's not what happened to you. In this lesson, Dr. Maté explains why traumatic wounds get triggered and how to understand triggers in your process of transformation and healing.
There is a strong link between childhood trauma and health challenges. Dr. Maté demonstrates how to untangle and understand this connection with self-compassion.

As humans, we are constantly struggling between the poles of what we think we want and what is. When we lose touch with the truth of what is, we create and compound our suffering. What narratives are you constructing? Are they in conflict with the truth of the situation? Are you struggling with what is?

The way you recall a memory and the way it actually happened might be completely different. The question is, do you know which version feeds you? We can become so wrapped up in our recollections, we convince ourselves of these untruths. Is that person a monster? Were they wishing you harm? Or were they dealing with a difficult situation in the best way they knew how?

Stop focusing on the object of your desires and start focusing on the reason for desiring that object in the first place. When you turn it around, you may find that what you really want is completely different than what you’ve been telling yourself.

A single thought plants the seed of a narrative. You feel lonely and unsupported, so, of course, someone must have abandoned you. Over time, the thought “I feel abandoned” grows into the story of an entire childhood. Let’s uproot the thought and untangle the story.

Fear is a fickle partner. While it certainly serves a purpose — keeping us out of danger and forcing us to question our assumptions — if we give too much of ourselves over to fear, it will lead us down paths filled with insecurity, broken social interactions, and a persistent struggle against the way things actually are.
Definitive statements are comforting. They give life structure and clear direction. But what happens when your declarations are at odds with your subconscious desires?

Today's lesson is a bit of a reality check, as we'll begin to question the current way we look at relationships, romantic or not. How we see ourselves and our relationship to God influences our view of our relationships with other people. Today we're going to examine that view from a place of love.

A miracle happens when you stop thinking with fear and start thinking with love. Your greatest power lies in your mind. To establish stronger connections, you need to go into every situation requesting to be an instrument of love. When you approach your interactions with love, you'll begin to have more miraculous relationships.

In the following lesson, we'll discover how the ego mind influences both our way of thinking and our relationships. We'll also identify the unconscious barriers we've built that cause us to form these judgments and thoughts. That's where the problem is, and that's where the solution lies.

The focus of today's lecture is this: atonement. While we decided to act a certain way in the past based on our personality, we can now use this information to improve our current and future relationships.

Raelene S. Weaver, author and TEDx speaker who's breaking barriers by normalizing boys' emotions. Witness a touching moment as a man in Italy feels a human touch after 30 years, and Daaji joins for another inspiring segment on our Soul Hugs series.

The body has inherent systems to slow and even reverse aging. When you activate these systems you increase stem cell production, reduce inflammation, increase antioxidant enzymes, build muscle, lose fat, and increase cognitive capacity.

Now that we understand the root causes of aging, how do we actually address the hallmarks of aging? What are the levers we have to optimize our health and longevity? Because medicine has it all wrong. We don't need to treat disease. When we focus on fostering optimal health, disease goes away as a side effect.

There are basic fundamental ways we can optimize our health, starting with topics we’ve already discussed, like eating well and exercising appropriately. But, just as important for health and longevity is the need to rest, relax, and connect with each other. Community is essential, and being of service to one another can help you heal.

Too much stress will take you down, but the right amount of stress at the right time can activate your body's repair and healing mechanisms. What natural elements stress our system in such a way that it then activates the body to heal?

programmes.t: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programmes.d: Grief is the death of something—someone, a relationship, a job, or a dream. There’s no timeline, and you cannot heal what you do not feel. Guided by David Kessler, this course helps you navigate your river of grief, honor your unique process, and find a path toward healing.

programmes.t: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programmes.d: Grief is about the heart, but the mind shapes the story we tell. While you can’t change the facts of loss, you can change the narrative, honor old wounds, and choose words that guide you toward growth, meaning, and deeper connection to joy and healing.

programmes.t: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programmes.d: Loss can make you feel powerless, but grief is your work and your power. David Kessler guides you to grieve fully on your terms, honor your unique process, and reclaim agency over your healing, showing that you can live fully while holding your pain with strength.

programmes.t: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programmes.d: Your survival mind is wired to protect you from pain, but after loss it can spiral into worry and worst-case thinking. Learn the science of grief, how repetitive thoughts form deep mental pathways, and how to rewire your mind to heal and grow.

Day 1 introduces the practice of centering through the breath. When the mind drifts to regret or worry, we gently return—again and again. This meditation teaches concentration, presence, and compassion, reminding us that healing isn’t in never wandering, but in beginning again.

Day 2 invites us to examine the stories we tell about our worth, limits, and lives. By recognizing conditioned habits and outdated coping tools, we reconnect with our power of choice. This lesson reminds us that change is always possible—and that we can meet life with renewed care and curiosity.

Day 3 focuses on meeting anger and fear with compassion rather than resistance. By paying gentle attention to difficult emotions, we learn they are not bad—only painful when they define us. Using the breath as an anchor, we develop a kinder, wiser relationship to our inner experience.

Day 4 explores opening to joy by intentionally taking in the good. We examine habits of threat, perfectionism, and resistance, and practice savoring what’s nourishing and life-giving. Through gentle curiosity, this lesson shows how joy can restore resilience and help us meet life with more ease.
